Title: 1. The Bridge on the River Kwai
description: British POWs are forced to build a railway bridge across the river Kwai for their Japanese captors in occupied Burma, not knowing that the allied forces are planning a daring commando raid through the jungle to destroy it.

Title: 2. An Affair to Remember
description: A couple falls in love and agrees to meet in six months at the Empire State Building - but will it happen?

Title: 3. Nights of Cabiria
description: A waifish prostitute wanders the streets of Rome looking for true love but finds only heartbreak.

Title: 4. Throne of Blood
description: A war-hardened general, egged on by his ambitious wife, works to fulfill a prophecy that he would become lord of Spider's Web Castle.

Title: 5. The Cranes Are Flying
description: Veronika plans a rendezvous with her lover Boris at the bank of the river, only for him to be drafted into World War II shortly thereafter.

Title: 6. Il Grido
description: A man wanders aimlessly away from his town, away from the woman he loves, emotionally and socially inactive.

Title: 7. 12 Angry Men
description: The jury in a New York City murder trial is frustrated by a single member whose skeptical caution forces them to more carefully consider the evidence before jumping to a hasty verdict.

Title: 8. Paths of Glory
description: A colonel defends three of his soldiers in a court-martial after they abandon a suicidal attack.

Title: 9. Witness for the Prosecution
description: A veteran British barrister must defend his client in a murder trial that has surprise after surprise.

Title: 10. The Seventh Seal
description: A knight returning to Sweden after the Crusades seeks answers about life, death, and the existence of God as he plays chess against the Grim Reaper during the Black Plague.

Title: 11. Wild Strawberries
description: After living a life marked by coldness, an aging professor is forced to confront the emptiness of his existence.

Title: 12. Sweet Smell of Success
description: A famous and powerful New York columnist gives a press agent some dirty work.

Title: 13. Funny Face
description: An impromptu fashion shoot at a book store brings about a new fashion model discovery in the shop clerk.

Title: 14. A Face in the Crowd
description: A TV woman turns a homespun bum into a rotten media hero.

Title: 15. Old Yeller
description: In 1860s Texas, a stray yellow dog proves his worth to a frontier family, especially bonding with their teenage son who must help manage their homestead while his father works a cattle drive.

Title: 16. Curse of the Demon
description: A man seeks to return a doctor's ancient death-curse.

Title: 17. Gunfight at the O.K. Corral
description: Lawman Wyatt Earp and outlaw Doc Holliday form an unlikely alliance which culminates in their participation in the legendary Gunfight at the O.K. Corral.

Title: 18. 3:10 to Yuma
description: A broke small-time rancher is hired to ensure a captured outlaw is placed on a train, and must contend with the outlaw's ruthless gang.

Title: 19. The Incredible Shrinking Man
description: After Scott Carey begins to shrink because of exposure to a combination of radiation and insecticide, medical science is powerless to help him.

Title: 20. The Enemy Below
description: During WWII an American destroyer discovers a German U-boat, and in the ensuing duel the American captain must draw upon all his experience to defeat the equally experienced German commander.

Title: 21. Love in the Afternoon
description: A middle-aged playboy becomes fascinated by the daughter of a private detective who has been hired to entrap him with the wife of a client.

Title: 22. The Deadly Mantis
description: A giant prehistoric praying mantis, recently freed from the Arctic ice, voraciously preys on American military at the DEW Line and works its way south.

Title: 23. The Curse of Frankenstein
description: While awaiting execution for murder, Baron Victor Frankenstein tells the story of a creature he built and brought to life - only for it to behave not as he intended.

Title: 24. Sayonara
description: A US Air Force major in Kobe confronts his own opposition to marriages between American servicemen and Japanese women after he falls for a beautiful performer.

Title: 25. White Nights
description: A humble clerk courts a woman who awaits her lover's return night after night.

Title: 26. Peyton Place
description: A peaceful New England town hides secrets and scandals.

Title: 27. Raintree County
description: A student falls in love with a Southern belle, but their relationship is complicated by her troubled past and the onset of the Civil War.

Title: 28. Heaven Knows, Mr. Allison
description: During World War II, an American marine and an Irish nun form an unlikely friendship after being stranded on a South Pacific island. They find comfort in one another while hoping for a rescue, as they try to avoid capture by the Japanese.

Title: 29. Kanal
description: In 1944, during the Warsaw uprising against the Nazis, Polish Lieutenant Zadra and his resistance fighters use Warsaw's sewer system to escape the German encirclement.

Title: 30. Not of This Earth
description: An alien agent from the distant planet Davana is sent to Earth via a high-tech matter transporter. There, he terrorizes Southern California in an attempt to acquire blood for his dying race, the result of a devastating nuclear war.

Title: 31. The Snow Queen
description: A young girl embarks on a perilous journey to rescue her friend, who has been taken captive by the Snow Queen and turned cruel by enchanted ice splinters.

Title: 32. No Down Payment
description: In California, four couples who have bought houses near one another face problems, alcoholism, racism, promiscuity, and discrimination against lack of education, until a tragic event forces them to reassess their lives.

Title: 33. The Abominable Snowman
description: A kindly English botanist and a gruff American scientist lead an expedition to the Himalayas in search of the legendary Yeti.

Title: 34. 20 Million Miles to Earth
description: The first U.S. spaceship to Venus crash-lands off the coast of Sicily on its return trip. A dangerous, lizard-like creature comes with it and quickly grows gigantic.

Title: 35. The Pajama Game
description: An Iowa pajama factory worker falls in love with an affable superintendent who was hired by the factory boss to deny the workers' demand for a pay raise.

Title: 36. Thirst
description: Vijay, a talented but indigent poet, struggles for love and recognition in this selfish world.

Title: 37. The One That Got Away
description: A cocky German fighter pilot is shot down over England in 1940 and makes numerous attempts to escape to fight again.

Title: 38. The Monster That Challenged the World
description: When a horde of prehistoric mollusk monsters enter the canal system of the California's Imperial Valley and terrorize the populace.

Title: 39. The Prince and the Showgirl
description: An American showgirl becomes entangled in political intrigue when the Prince Regent of a foreign country attempts to seduce her.

Title: 40. Jailhouse Rock
description: After serving time for manslaughter, young Vince Everett becomes a teenage rock star.

Title: 41. Quatermass 2
description: Professor Quatermass, trying to gather support for his Lunar colonisation project, is intrigued by mysterious traces that have been showing up.

Title: 42. The Spirit of St. Louis
description: Charles 'Slim' Lindbergh struggles to finance and design an airplane that will make his New York to Paris flight the first solo transatlantic crossing.

Title: 43. Mother India
description: In this melodrama, a poverty-stricken woman raises her sons through many trials and tribulations. But no matter the struggles, she always sticks to her own moral code.

Title: 44. A Farewell to Arms
description: An English nurse and an American ambulance driver on the Italian front during World War 1 fall in love, but the horrors surrounding them challenge their romance to the limit.

Title: 45. Jet Pilot
description: Air Force Colonel Jim Shannon is tasked to escort a defecting Soviet pilot who is scheming to lure Shannon to the USSR.

Title: 46. Men in War
description: During the Korean War, a battle-worn lieutenant and his platoon are behind enemy lines, and have orders to march to Hill 465 for possible relief.

Title: 47. Edge of the City
description: A railroad worker in New York forms a close bond with his African American coworker while they both endure harassment from their hostile supervisor.

Title: 48. Raquel's Shoeshiner
description: The film tells an episode of the life of a kindly hearted bootblack who becomes accidentally the tutor of an orphan but nevertheless spends all his time and effort for the sake of the boy.

Title: 49. The 27th Day
description: Aliens take five people, give them small capsules which can kill mankind without additional damage, with the understanding they will colonize Earth only if they use the weapons.

Title: 50. The Wayward Bus
description: Three strangers - a stripper, an alcoholic wife and a travelling salesman - embark on a life-changing journey. As the road presents challenges, each character faces his or her own shortcomings, not knowing where life will lead next.

Title: 51. Voodoo Island
description: A scholarly type is asked to investigate the possible island site for a large resort hotel--an island rumored to be infested with zombies.

Title: 52. Night Ambush
description: Led by British officers, partisans on Crete plan to kidnap the island's German commander and smuggle him to Cairo, Egypt to embarrass the occupiers.

Title: 53. Battle Hymn
description: A remorseful bomber pilot-turned-minister rejoins for the Korean War.

Title: 54. Godzilla
description: Godzilla's initial 1957 French theatrical debut resulted in an entirely different version of the film altogether, combining Toho's original Gojira with elements of the re-edited US release with Raymond Burr.

Title: 55. The Strange One
description: Students faced with an ethical dilemma about the dehumanization associated with the tradition of hazing, at a military college in the Southern United States, take matters in their own hands.

Title: 56. Tokyo 1960
description: A giant monster blasts Tokyo.

Title: 57. Ghost Diver
description: Rico, a South American diver, seeking the lost treasure of the Paracas, finds a Paracan idol, with its eyes of sun and moon, and realizes he has found the key to a fortune. He tells Manco, the sweetheart of his daughter Pele, and the greedy Manco cuts the lifeline to Rico's diving gear and watches the old man sink to the ocean floor. The idol, with both eyes now missing, comes into the hands of star of a television adventure series Roger Bristol, who, with his son Robin and secretary Anne Stevens, sets out to find the lost treasure.

Title: 58. All Mine to Give
description: An immigrant family in 1850's Wisconsin prospers until tragedy strikes.

Title: 59. Mayabazar
description: Balarama promises Subhadra to get his daughter married to her son. But when the Pandavas loses their kingdom to the Kaurava's, Balarama breaks his promise.

Title: 60. The Tall T
description: An independent former ranch foreman is kidnapped along with an heiress, who is being held for ransom by trio of ruthless outlaws.

Title: 61. Zero Hour!
description: In 1950s Canada, during a commercial flight, the pilots and some passengers suffer food poisoning, thus forcing an ex-WWII fighter pilot (Dana Andrews) to try to land the airliner in heavy fog.

Title: 62. Shoot-Out at Medicine Bend
description: In Medicine Bend, a crooked businessman has the town mayor and sheriff in his pocket while his henchmen raid the wagon trains passing through the region.

Title: 63. Paradise Lagoon
description: In 1905, Lord Henry Loam and his family and servants are shipwrecked on a deserted island where the survival of the fittest renders the rigid class system irrelevant.

Title: 64. Charmants garçons
description: Glamorous French night-club singer plays the field of male admirers.

Title: 65. The Three Faces of Eve
description: A doctor treats a woman suffering from Multiple Personality Disorder.

Title: 66. The Tin Star
description: A cynical former sheriff turned bounty hunter helps a young, recently appointed acting sheriff with his advice, his experience and his gun.

Title: 67. A King in New York
description: A recently deposed European monarch takes shelter in New York City, where he becomes an accidental television celebrity and is later wrongly accused of being a Communist.

Title: 68. Hell Drivers
description: An ex-convict trying to go clean ends up working for a crooked trucking company.

Title: 69. Desk Set
description: Two extremely strong personalities clash over the computerization of a television network's research department.

Title: 70. The Sun Also Rises
description: A group of disillusioned American expatriate writers live a dissolute, hedonistic lifestyle in 1920s France and Spain.

Title: 71. Kronos
description: Aliens from another world send a huge robotic accumulator to invade the Earth and absorb all energy it comes in contact with.

Title: 72. The Monolith Monsters
description: Rocks from a meteor which grow when in contact with water threaten a sleepy Southwestern desert community.

Title: 73. The Wings of Eagles
description: A biography of Navy flier-turned-screenwriter Frank W. "Spig" Wead. The pioneering aviator who turned to writing after being grounded by an accident.

Title: 74. Tammy and the Bachelor
description: An unsophisticated young woman from the Mississippi swamps falls in love with an unconventional southern gentleman.

Title: 75. Attack of the Crab Monsters
description: Scientists become trapped on a shrinking island with intelligent, murderous giant crabs.

Title: 76. Pal Joey
description: Joey Evans is a charming, handsome, funny, talented 1st class, A-Number 1 heel. When Joey meets the former chorus girl and now rich widow Vera Simpson, the pair of lecherous souls seem made for each other.

Title: 77. Untamed Youth
description: Two vagrant sisters work for crooked characters at a rock'n'roll prison-farm.

Title: 78. The Vampire
description: A Mexican girl returns home for an aunt's funeral. She hears town rumors about vampires. She suspects her other aunt and neighbor are involved with vampires.

Title: 79. The Singing Ringing Tree
description: A brave prince wants to win the heart of a stubborn princess by finding the singing, ringing tree for her.

Title: 80. Beginning of the End
description: Enterprising journalist Audrey Ames (Peggie Castle) is determined to get the scoop on enormous grasshoppers that were accidentally created at the Illinois State experimental farm, and she endeavors to save Chicago despite a military cover-up.

Title: 81. Man of a Thousand Faces
description: The life and career of vaudevillian and silent-screen horror star Lon Chaney, including his contentious relationship with his neurotic wife and his premature death.

Title: 82. The Giant Claw
description: Scientists ponder a buzzard--like big bird able to lift a train.

Title: 83. The Tattered Dress
description: After top lawyer James Blane gets an acquittal for Michael Reston who killed another man for sexually roughing up his trophy wife, the murderous town sheriff frames him for bribing a juror in the case.

Title: 84. Les Girls
description: The former members of a dance troupe are suing because of recently published memoirs. Each one insists on own point of view.

Title: 85. Silk Stockings
description: A Russian government official is sent to Paris to bring back her comrades; she soon gets a taste of Paris life and falls in love with an American movie producer.

Title: 86. The Pride and the Passion
description: During the Napoleonic Wars, a British captain is sent to Spain to help prevent the French from stealing a powerful cannon.

Title: 87. The Man Without a Body
description: A wealthy business man discovers he has a brain tumor and seeks medical help. The business man finds a scientist experimenting with transplanting monkey heads on different monkey bodies. The business man decides to steal the head of Nostradamus from the prophet's crypt.

Title: 88. Designing Woman
description: A sportswriter and a fashion-designer have a lot of adjusting to do when they marry after a whirlwind romance, and discover they have little in common.

Title: 89. Night Passage
description: A fired railroad man is re-hired and entrusted to carry a ten thousand dollar payroll in secret, even though he is suspected of being connected to outlaws.

Title: 90. Legend of the Lost
description: American ne'er-do-well Joe January is hired to take Paul Bonnard on an expedition into the desert in search of treasure.

Title: 91. Saint Joan
description: In 1456, French King Charles VII recalls the story of how he met the seventeen-year-old peasant girl Joan of Arc, entrusted her with the command of the French Army, and ultimately burned her at the stake as a heretic.

Title: 92. Your Past Is Showing
description: A very British comedy about a blackmailer and his victims.

Title: 93. Loving You
description: A talented delivery man's life changes when a publicist and musician spot his potential. As they guide him to stardom, he navigates romantic tensions between a devoted fellow singer and the ambitious publicist promising him success.

Title: 94. Boy on a Dolphin
description: A woman who finds a treasure is torn between two men: one who wants to sell it, and one who wants to donate it to Greece.

Title: 95. I Was a Teenage Werewolf
description: A hypnotherapist uses a temperamental teenager as a guinea pig for a serum which transforms him into a vicious werewolf.

Title: 96. The Vampire
description: A kind, small-town doctor mistakenly ingests pills made from vampire bat blood and they turn him into a dangerous fanged creature.

Title: 97. Will Success Spoil Rock Hunter?
description: To save his career, a writer for television advertising wants a famous actress to endorse a lipstick. In return, he has to pretend to be her new lover.

Title: 98. Forty Guns
description: Showdown in Arizona between the Bonell brothers - U.S. Marshals - and Jessica Drummond, the iron-fisted rancher who controls the territory.

Title: 99. Invasion of the Saucer Men
description: Aliens equipped with venomous claws invade a small town but the town's teenage population is mobilized to fight the menace.

Title: 100. Tokyo Twilight
description: Two sisters find out the existence of their long-lost mother, but the younger cannot take the truth of being abandoned as a child.

Title: 101. The Black Scorpion
description: Volcanic activity frees giant scorpions from the earth who wreak havoc in the rural countryside and eventually threaten Mexico City.

Title: 102. Teenage Doll
description: A delinquent girls' gang pursues a nice ingenue linked romantically to the male leader of a rival gang, and apparently to the murder of one of their members.

Title: 103. The Undead
description: A beautiful woman is sent back in time via hypnosis to the Middle Ages where she finds she is suspected of being a witch, and subject to being executed.

Title: 104. The Burglar
description: A gang of thieves robs a fake spiritualist and then takes it on the lam to Atlantic City.

Title: 105. The Lower Depths
description: In a Japanese slum, various residents play out their lives, dreaming of better things or settling for their lot. Among them is a man who pines for a young woman but is stymied by her deceptive family.

Title: 106. From Hell It Came
description: A wrongfully accused South Seas prince is executed, and returns as a walking tree stump.

Title: 107. Lust of the Vampire
description: Paris. Young girls are found dead, drained of their blood. A journalist investigates these murders while the beautiful Giselle, from a noble family, tries to seduce him.

Title: 108. Decision at Sundown
description: Bart Allison and sidekick Sam arrive in the town of Sundown on the wedding day of town boss Tate Kimbrough, whom Allison blames for his wife's death years earlier.

Title: 109. The Amazing Colossal Man
description: A military officer survives a nuclear blast, then begins to grow uncontrollably, into an increasingly-unstable giant.

Title: 110. Pickup Alley
description: International narcotics smuggler Frank McNally is trailed through various European countries by U.S. drug enforcement agent Charles Sturgis.

Title: 111. Blue Murder at St. Trinian's
description: The girls of St. Trinian's School go on a bus tour of Italy chaperoned by a diamond thief disguised as a woman to elude the police.

Title: 112. The Brain from Planet Arous
description: An evil alien brain from the planet Arous hijacks the body of an Earth scientist in order to control the Earth.

Title: 113. Seven Days from Now
description: After hitting a derelict mine in the Atlantic Ocean, a ship's officer finds himself in command of a lifeboat full of survivors of a sunken luxury liner. The survivors fight to stay alive while exposed to savage seas and each other.

Title: 114. My Man Godfrey
description: The spoiled daughter of a rich American family hires as butler an Austrian vagrant she finds on a pier, without knowing that he illegally jumped ship.

Title: 115. This Could Be the Night
description: A school teacher takes a part-time secretarial job evenings in a nightclub. The two club owners quibble about a lot, including her. Unfortunately, she develops an interest for the partner who disapproves of her employment at the club.

Title: 116. The Girl in Black Stockings
description: A party girl is murdered, and everyone at a Utah motel is a suspect.

Title: 117. Time Limit
description: During the Korean War former prisoner of war, Major Harry Cargill admits to having collaborated with the enemy but military investigator Colonel William Edwards wants the details.

Title: 118. Johnny Tremain
description: Johnny Tremain is drawn into the Revolutionary War, and becomes a patriot fighting to free the colonies from England. Along the way he learns about life and about himself.

Title: 119. Fear Strikes Out
description: True story of the life of Jimmy Piersall, who battled mental illness to achieve stardom in major league baseball.

Title: 120. The Land Unknown
description: Three men and a woman crash-land in a deep crater in Antarctica, where they find a prehistoric world.

Title: 121. The Story of Mankind
description: The Devil and the Spirit of Man argue as to whether or not humanity is ultimately good or evil.

Title: 122. The Secret Place
description: A beautiful redhead becomes involved with a group of small-time hoodlums who plan and perform a daring diamond robbery.

Title: 123. You Pay Your Money
description: A rogue smuggler enters the world of intrigue and deception, when he finds that his wife has been kidnapped his world changes.

Title: 124. The Tarnished Angels
description: Story of the fraught friendship between an eccentric journalist and a team of daredevil flying acrobats.

Title: 125. She Devil
description: Biochemists' serum gives a woman side effects.

Title: 126. Kiss Them for Me
description: In 1944, three Navy pilots stationed in Hawaii and a P.R. officer go on a 4-day leave to San Francisco where they party with a good crowd in the executive suite of a busy hotel.

Title: 127. Brothers in Law
description: Roger Thursby is just starting out as a barrister, full of ideals, but he is a bit too keen in the opinion of his fellow lawyers.

Title: 128. The Tall Stranger
description: Back from the Civil War, an ex-Yankee officer helps a wagon train of former Confederates to settle in a prosperous valley marred by cattle rustling and land grabbing feuds.

Title: 129. The Big Land
description: Alan Ladd stars as a Kansas cattle rancher battling the elements and corrupt cattle buyers to build a railroad spur to the Rio Grande just after the United States Civil War.

Title: 130. The Parisian
description: Set against the picturesque springtime in Paris, the Prime Minister of France's daughter marries a buttoned down cabinet official, but after her new husband starts stepping out behind her back, the young bride takes off for the Riviera.

Title: 131. Across the Bridge
description: A wealthy businessman in New York absconds to Mexico by train in order to avoid capture for embezzlement. On the way, he steals the identity of another man for a visa, but that only complicates matters.

Title: 132. Run of the Arrow
description: After the South loses the war, Confederate veteran O'Meara goes West, joins the Sioux, takes a wife and refuses to be an American but he must choose a side when the Sioux go to war against the U.S. Army.

Title: 133. Operation Mad Ball
description: In post-WWII France, U.S. Army hospital Private Hogan and Captain Lock try to outwit each other on issues such as wooing pretty nurses, accounting for missing medical supplies, organizing unauthorized dances, and influencing their C.O.

Title: 134. The Hard Man
description: A lawman becomes a deputy in a town where he suspects the friend he had to kill in self-defense, was framed for murder.

Title: 135. Island in the Sun
description: This drama set during the 1950s on a British-ruled Caribbean island deals with local politics, interracial relationships, social inequality, racism, adultery, and murder.

Title: 136. The Mysterians
description: Shortly after a giant robot destroys a village, aliens from outer space arrive offering friendship. Will the people of Earth tie these two events together?

Title: 137. The Little Hut
description: While shipwrecked on a deserted island, best friends Philip Ashlow and Henry Brittingham-Brett compete against each other for the affections of the only woman available, Philip Ashlow's neglected wife, Susan.

Title: 138. Until They Sail
description: During WWII, unmarried New Zealand women meet and marry American soldiers who are fighting in the Pacific theater.

Title: 139. The Invisible Boy
description: A ten-year-old boy and Robby the Robot team up to prevent a Super Computer from controlling the Earth from a satellite.

Title: 140. Wild Is the Wind
description: An immigrant Nevada rancher brings a woman from Italy to be his second wife, but when he neglects her she becomes involved with his trusted assistant.

Title: 141. A Hatful of Rain
description: A Korean War veteran's morphine addiction wreaks havoc upon his family.

Title: 142. Sissi: The Fateful Years of an Empress
description: The final film in a highly romanticized trilogy about Elisabeth "Sissi" of Austria finds the young empress traveling throughout Europe.

Title: 143. The Joker Is Wild
description: Frank Sinatra plays Joe E. Lewis, a famous comedian of the 1930s-50s. When the movie opens, Lewis is a young, talented singer who performs in speakeasies. After he bolts one job for another, the mob boss who owns the first speakeasy has his thugs try to kill Lewis. He survives, but his vocal cords are cut and he cannot sing. Several years later, his buddy tracks him down and tries to help him, with little success. That attempt, though, leads to Lewis meeting Letty Page (Jeanne Crain). They fall in love and she inspires him to follow up on an offer to become a comedian (a result of his buddy's failed attempt to rejuvenate his singing career). Lewis has problems, though. The assault that nearly cost him his life also helped turn him into an alcoholic and an inveterate gambler. These two character defects become the basis for his act and help to make him a smash success. Unfortunately, they also work to wreak havoc in his personal life.

Title: 144. Short Cut to Hell
description: A hired killer's latest contract goes awry when he's paid with stolen money and finds himself embroiled in a deadly cat-and-mouse game with those who hired him.

Title: 145. Big Time Operators
description: A young couple inherits a debt-ridden old movie theater, appropriately nicknamed "The Flea Pit", and the three eccentric senior citizens who work there.

Title: 146. The Saga of the Viking Women and Their Voyage to the Waters of the Great Sea Serpent
description: A group of lonely Viking women build a ship and set off across the sea to locate their missing menfolk, only to fall into the clutches of the barbarians that also hold their men captive. There is a cameo appearance by the sea serpent.

Title: 147. He Who Must Die
description: Three townspeople cause an uproar when they try to help refugees on a Greek island occupied by Turks.

Title: 148. Time Without Pity
description: The day before a young man is to be executed for killing his girlfriend, his alcoholic father shows up to try and prove his innocence.

Title: 149. Fire Down Below
description: A pair of small-time smugglers in the Caribbean have a falling out over their mutual lust for a hot-to-trot floozy who has a weakness for any man who treats her with kindness.

Title: 150. The Lonely Man
description: Aging gunslinger Jacob Wade hopes to settle down with his estranged son, but his old enemies have other plans for him.

Title: 151. The Devil Strikes at Night
description: A serial killer strikes again during World War II in Germany. The wrong man is arrested and a detective hunts down the real killer, but justice in Nazi Germany is not so easily administered.

Title: 152. The True Story of Jesse James
description: Biopic loosely based on the last 18 years of Jesse James' life and focused on the relationship between brothers Jesse and Frank James.

Title: 153. The D.I.
description: A no-nonsense drill instructor is convinced that he can make a recruit, who is haunted by his family combat history and who falters under pressure, into a Marine.

Title: 154. The Cyclops
description: An expedition to Mexico finds and does battle with a mutated 25-foot man with one big eye.

Title: 155. Band of Angels
description: Amantha Starr grows up as a privileged Southern belle in the ante-bellum South, but after her father dies broke, her world is destroyed when she discovers that her mother was Black.

Title: 156. The Guns of Fort Petticoat
description: Union Army deserter, Lt. Hewitt, trains a ragtag band of all-female homesteaders to defend themselves against a Comanche tribe on the warpath.

Title: 157. The Unearthly
description: Mad doctor uses patients at his isolated psychiatric institute as subjects in his attempts to create longevity by surgically installing an artificial gland in their skulls, with disastrous results.

Title: 158. Hour of Decision
description: An American journalist solves the mystery of an unpleasant columnist's murder and clears his own wife, one of the many suspects.

Title: 159. Hellcats of the Navy
description: The daring exploits of a submarine commander whose mission is to chart the minefields in the waters of Japan during World War II.

Title: 160. Sorority Girl
description: Feeling alienated by her mother, a poor little rich girl enacts a string of torments on her classmates at a girls' boarding school; she increasingly aggravates them until she goes too far.

Title: 161. Love Slaves of the Amazons
description: A party of explorers in the Amazon jungle are captured by a tribe of women, and learn that they are to be used as the tribe's "love slaves."

Title: 162. Back from the Dead
description: A newly-married young woman is possessed by the evil spirit of her husband's deceased first wife. The possession turns her into a scheming killer who will stop at nothing to get what she wants.

Title: 163. The Garment Jungle
description: The struggle of a lady's garment workers' organization to unionize a New York clothing sweat shop; the owner of which is determined to keep the union out of his business at any cost.

Title: 164. Do Ankhen Barah Haath
description: Progressive, reform-minded young warden gets permission to take six surly murderers from prison to dilapidated country farm, to rehabilitate it and themselves through hard work and kindly guidance.

Title: 165. The Astounding She-Monster
description: After kidnapping a rich heiress, a gang of crooks is confronted by a beautiful, but lethal alien whose spaceship crash-landed on Earth.

Title: 166. The Female Animal
description: An aging film star and her alcoholic daughter compete for a handsome extra.

Title: 167. Monster from Green Hell
description: A scientific expedition in Africa investigates wasps that have been exposed to radiation and mutated into giant, killing monsters.

Title: 168. Gun Glory
description: A gunfighter defends his town when cattlemen threaten to destroy it by stampeding cattle through the farmlands.

Title: 169. Nine Lives
description: During World War II, nine members of the Norwegian Resistance are trapped by the Germans in a deadly ambush. Only one escapes, and a fierce hunt through the ice desert begins.

Title: 170. Jeanne Eagels
description: The life of 1920s actress Jeanne Eagels.

Title: 171. Istanbul
description: A suspected diamond smuggler returns to Istanbul and finds the lady love he thought was dead...or does he?

Title: 172. The Helen Morgan Story
description: Torch singer Helen Morgan rises from sordid beginnings to fame and fortune only to lose it all to alcohol and poor personal choices.

Title: 173. The Beasts of Marseilles
description: Escaping British prisoners of war hide out in German-occupied France.

Title: 174. The Shiralee
description: After Jim Macauley finds his wife with another man, he takes their young daughter and they hit the road. With a young child as his responsibility, he finds he can't be quite the fancy-free wanderer that he had been.

Title: 175. Man in the Shadow
description: Virgil Renchler owns most of the town, providing a thriving economy. After his men go too far and kill one of his migrant workmen, the sheriff goes after him, even if it means his job and everyone else's.

Title: 176. A Novel Affair
description: A chauffeur gets the wrong idea after he reads his lady boss's erotic novel.

Title: 177. I Was a Teenage Frankenstein
description: Professor Frankenstein creates a hulking teenager from the body of an accident victim; his "creation" awakens and goes on a killing spree.

Title: 178. House of Numbers
description: San Quentin prison inmate Arnie Judlow asks his twin brother Bill and his wife Ruth to assist him in a daring escape plan.

Title: 179. The Big Caper
description: A "confidence couple" pose as husband and wife while attempting a bank heist.

Title: 180. Dobrý voják Svejk
description: Mrs Müllerova (E. Svobodova) informs her tenant Svejk (R. Hrusinsky) about the recent assassination of Archduke Ferdinand. Svejk heads out to the local pub unaware that a secret police agent is also in there spying on people who talk about political subjects. After foolishly talking to the agent Svejk gets arrested for treason but soon after gets released on the account of being deemed officially stupid. Despite suffering from rheumatism Svejk decides to enlist in the army...

Title: 181. Man on Fire
description: A wealthy businessman whose wife has divorced him, is bitter about the divorce, and prevents his ex-wife from seeing their child. She takes him to court, and a judge tries to determine what will be best for the child.

Title: 182. Trooper Hook
description: When Apache chief Nanchez is captured by the cavalry, his white squaw and infant son are returned to civilization by Sergeant Hook, but Nanchez escapes custody and attempts to re-claim his son.

Title: 183. The Disembodied
description: A photographer on an expedition in the jungle runs afoul of a voodoo cult.

Title: 184. The Delicate Delinquent
description: Sidney Pythias is a bumbling janitor picked up by cop Mike Damon as a teenage gang member worth saving from delinquency. With Damon's help, Sidney works his way through the Police Academy to become a cop too.

Title: 185. Naya Daur
description: When the son of a landlord decides to modernize his business by replacing the horse carts with buses, a horse cart rider decides to challenge him.

Title: 186. Hora y media de balazos
description: A brave bandit helps a town fight against a greedy man who controls their water supply. Through misunderstandings and sheer luck, he's mistaken for someone else while aiding Margarita and the locals in their struggle.

Title: 187. The Unholy Wife
description: A gold-digger floozy marries a wealthy wine producer but she secretly takes a young lover with whom she conspires to murder her husband for his fortune.

Title: 188. Curfew Breakers
description: Lt. Lacey heads a crackdown on dope-peddling to high-school athletes. One dies from an overdose, two more kill a gas-station attendant in a holdup attempt, and another dies in a condemned empty building while fleeing from the law.

Title: 189. Cien muchachas
description: Don Manuel is a successful bathing suit designer that decides to retire tired of his business. While doing so, he announces he will leave his company in the hands of his own employers. If during a year they manage to increase the sales of their designs, he will leave the company in their hands definitively. Otherwise, it will be inherited by his three spoiled nieces. Annoyed by the fact that his uncle has refuse them the company, the three girls plot to seduce the workers leaders in order to make them fail in their sales goal so they can recover the company.

Title: 190. The Crucible
description: Salem 1692. The young Abigail, seduced and abandoned by John Proctor, accuses John's wife of being a witch in revenge. It will be the beginning of a series of witchcraft trials and a dark moment in American history.

Title: 191. Woman in a Dressing Gown
description: A middle-aged married woman is shocked to discover that her husband, whom she thought was content in their marriage, has become infatuated with a beautiful younger woman and plans to leave his family for her.

Title: 192. Utah Blaine
description: Gunslinger Utah Blaine rescues rancher Joe Neal from lynching by vigilante land-grabbers and runs afoul of their leader Russ Nevers' interests.

Title: 193. My Gun Is Quick
description: Private eye Mike Hammer passes over beautiful women and corpses to find stolen jewels.

Title: 194. Black River
description: A love triangle develops between a benevolent student, his innocent girlfriend, and a cruel petty criminal, all as a point of diagnosis of a social disease that had Japan slowly succumbing to lawlessness during the post-War era.

Title: 195. The Twilight Girls
description: Young woman flees scandal, enrolls in elite girls' boarding school. She gets entangled in a world of seduction and temptation, leading to unforeseen consequences.

Title: 196. The Bachelor Party
description: Five office friends meet up for a night on the town to celebrate the forthcoming marriage of one of them. As the night wears on and the drink starts to tell, they become more confidential in expressing their concerns and hopes.

Title: 197. Bitter Victory
description: A commander receives a citation for an attack on Erwin Rommel's headquarters, which is actually undeserved, as the commander is unfit for his job. On top of that, unbeknownst to him, his wife is having an affair with one of his officers.

Title: 198. She Played with Fire
description: An insurance investigator reunites with an ex-girlfriend who is still as beautiful as he remembered her, but is now married. He soon finds himself involved in arson, blackmail and murder.

Title: 199. War Drums
description: The friendship between a white man and an Apache chief is tested when they fall in love with the same woman during a time of frontier conflict.

Title: 200. Los jueves, milagro
description: In the village of Fuentecilla is a medicinal spa which was very popular in the past but has now been forgotten by the public. To bring back the tourists, the "prominent men" of the village organize a fake miracle: the apparition of San Dimas, the local patron saint, which will take place every Thursday night. At first it works, but trouble begins when a stranger appears, claiming that he knows what's going on and making peculiar demands in exchange for his silence.

Title: 201. China Gate
description: In 1954, during the French Indochina War, an Eurasian female smuggler and a group of French Foreign Legion mercenaries, infiltrate the enemy territory in order to destroy an arms depot.

Title: 202. The Long Haul
description: After leaving his U.S. Army job in Germany, a trucker takes a long-haul driver job in Britain where he runs into an organized-crime syndicate that controls the trucking industry.

Title: 203. Quiet Flows the Don
description: An epic story of shattered lives of the Don Cossacks through chaos of World War I, the Russian Revolution, and the following Civil War.

Title: 204. Account Rendered
description: Police find that everyone had a motive for the murder of a wealthy woman.

Title: 205. The Accursed
description: Survivors of the World War 2 German Resistance Group attend an annual reunion at an English country house. The reunion is hosted by Colonel Price, who intends to find out which guest had betrayed their leader.

Title: 206. Naked Paradise
description: Gangster Zach Cotton and his two henchmen, Mitch and Stony, try to get a boat to escape from a tropical island after a botched robbery heist.

Title: 207. Baby Face Nelson
description: George "Babyface" Nelson became one of the most important gangsters of 1930's Chicago by making brutal robberies. In order to compete with Al Capone, he allied himself with John Dillinger.

Title: 208. Cat Girl
description: Leonora Johnson is a woman who returns to her ancestral home and is told she will inherit money, but also that there is a family curse: being possessed by the spirit of a leopard in spite of her disbelieving psychiatrist Dr. Brian Marlowe.

Title: 209. The Midnight Story
description: After a San Francisco priest is murdered, a policeman, who's a close friend, starts an investigation.

Title: 210. Teatro del crimen
description: The show must continue after a murder is committed inside a famous theater, in order to keep everyone inside while trying to discover the killer.

Title: 211. The Oklahoman
description: A doctor stops in a small Southwestern town to bury his wife. He decides to stay there and start a practice, but soon runs into violent cattle ranchers.

Title: 212. How to Murder a Rich Uncle
description: The impoverished Clitterburn family live on a grand English estate but times are hard and the head of the household, Sir Henry, seizes upon news of the impending arrival of their rich Canadian Uncle George as the solution to their financial troubles.

Title: 213. The Night the World Exploded
description: Dr. Conway has perfected a machine that predicts earthquakes, and has determined that one will strike California within 24 hours. A computer analysis determines that the entire world would explode within a little more than 28 days.

Title: 214. Blood of Dracula
description: Under hypnosis, a young woman turns into a vampire.

Title: 215. Something of Value
description: In British Colonial Kenya during the Mau Mau uprising, Peter and Kimani, who grew up together, find themselves on the opposite sides.

Title: 216. Zombies of Mora Tau
description: Zombie-like, dead crewmen of a sunken ship have always prevented salvagers from claiming the wreck's legendary box of diamonds, but will a new group of treasure hunters succeed?

Title: 217. Doctor at Large
description: Recent medical graduate Dr. Sparrow navigates humorous internships with eccentric mentors. After insulting a senior surgeon, he impresses hospital officials through timely intervention, securing a staff position.

Title: 218. Fury at Showdown
description: After serving a year for a killing in self-defense, gunfighter Brock Mitchell tries to help his younger brother save his ranch but a crooked lawyer has other ideas.

Title: 219. The River's Edge
description: A murderous thief on the run with stolen loot forces a poor rancher to guide him across the desert into Mexico. Accompanying them is the rancher's wife, who happens to be the killer's former girlfriend.

Title: 220. Sea Wife
description: A WWII shipwreck strands four survivors on a lifeboat: a woman, an officer, an administrator, and a seaman. As they struggle to survive, hidden truths and true natures emerge. Years later, the officer seeks the woman, unaware she's a nun.

Title: 221. The Unknown Terror
description: A millionaire leads an expedition into a remote jungle to find his wife's long-lost brother, but instead the group finds a mad scientist who has created a fungus monster that feeds on the local inhabitants.

Title: 222. The Brothers Rico
description: A retired mob accountant is drawn back in after his brothers, who have recently made a hit for the organization, decide to go to the authorities.

Title: 223. Domino Kid
description: After the Civil War, a Confederate veteran must track down five outlaws who murdered his father and ransacked his farm during the war.

Title: 224. The Seventh Sin
description: In post-WWII Hong Kong, unhappily married Carol has an affair with a married man. Her husband discovers it and presents her with a choice: travel with him to a remote mainland village or face the scandal of a very public divorce.

Title: 225. Town on Trial
description: At a local tennis club in a posh London suburb, an attractive but flirty young woman is murdered, prompting a Scotland Yard investigation.

Title: 226. The Goddess of Love
description: The god Zeus sends Venus, the goddess of love, to Earth to find her own true love.

Title: 227. All at Sea
description: A seasick sea captain commands an amusement pier despite local opposition.

Title: 228. Reform School Girl
description: A young man steals a car and ends up involved in a pedestrian fatality. The only witness is a girl he had just met. He threatens her life if she talks, so when she refuses to tell what she knows, she is sent to reform school.

Title: 229. The Story of Esther Costello
description: A wealthy woman aids a deaf-blind teen orphan from her Irish village, becoming a mother figure. She must protect the girl from exploitative promoters and her ex-husband's schemes.

Title: 230. The Steel Bayonet
description: A small band of British soldiers is sent on a mission to hold up a German advance.

Title: 231. Battle Hell
description: In 1949, during the Chinese Civil War, British warship H.M.S. Amethyst sails up the Yangtse river but on the return trip, finds its way blocked by a barrage of fire from the Communist Chinese shore batteries.

Title: 232. Tarzan and the Lost Safari
description: Tarzan leads five passengers from a downed airplane out of the jungle. En route, white hunter Hawkins tries to sell them to the Oparian chief. Captured by the Oparians and nearly sacrificed to their lion god, the party is saved by Tarzan.

Title: 233. The Buster Keaton Story
description: An inaccurate retelling of the life of silent filmmaker and comedian Buster Keaton.

Title: 234. The Gates of Paris
description: An old bum becomes infatuated with a pretty young girl who gets entangled with a gangster.

Title: 235. Don't Go Near the Water
description: On a small South Pacific island during WW2, various US Navy P.R. personnel pass the time romancing the nurses and the native girls while trying to avoid front line sea duty.

Title: 236. Ride Out for Revenge
description: After an Indian chief is murdered in a hostile town, a sympathetic ex-marshal tries to stop the Indians from attacking for revenge.

Title: 237. Oh, Men! Oh, Women!
description: A bored housewife seeks help from a psychiatrist who also solves his own emotional problems.

Title: 238. Slaughter on 10th Avenue
description: A brave longshoreman lingers on after being gunned down by three racketeers as a determined assistant D.A. searches hard for fearful witnesses against the men.

Title: 239. Tizoc
description: A white woman enters into a romance with a Mexican Indian. The racial barriers between the lovers prove to be insurmountable, resulting in tragedy.

Title: 240. Pawnee
description: Raised by Pawnees, a white man becomes a wagon train scout. When his adoptive chief dies seeking peace, the new leader Crazy Fox attacks the settlers.

Title: 241. April Love
description: A young man visiting his relatives' farm in Kentucky falls in love with their neighbor.

Title: 242. Hell Bound
description: After World War II, a Los Angeles crime ring uses a complex scheme, involving a freight ship, a junkie, and a corrupt health officer, to smuggle drugs into the USA.

Title: 243. Pharaoh's Curse
description: A crazed Egyptian follows the members of an archaeology expedition and kills them off one by one while getting progressively older.

Title: 244. Lucky Jim
description: Jim Dixon struggles with university work, Professor Welch's boring behavior, and his neurotic friend Margaret Peel. His misery is further complicated by his son Bertrand and companion Christine Callaghan.

Title: 245. Perri
description: True-life nature photography is used to tell the tale of a female tree squirrel named Perri who encounters many different forest creatures, both friendly and dangerous, as she grows up through the four seasons and finds a mate named Porro.

Title: 246. Ten Thousand Bedrooms
description: In this musical comedy, Dean Martin plays an American hotel mogul who becomes smitten with a young Italian woman (Anna Maria Alberghetti) when buying a hotel in Rome. To marry this gal, he has to get her three older sisters married off.

Title: 247. Portland Exposé
description: A tavern owner in mid-century Portland, Oregon finds the safety of himself and his family threatened when he becomes involved in a war between labor unions and a violent local crime syndicate.

Title: 248. The Delinquents
description: A clean-cut teen gets mixed up with some tire slashers.

Title: 249. Joe Dakota
description: A stranger rides into town and says he is looking for a local Indian. Told he left town, the truth everyone has been hiding comes out, including the stranger's true identity.

Title: 250. The James Dean Story
description: This documentary, which was undertaken soon after James Dean's death, looks at Dean's life through the use of still photographs with narration, and interviews with many of the people involved in his short life.

Title: 251. No Road Back
description: A blind and deaf woman dedicates her life and sacrifices all she has for her son, a good-for-nothing troublemaker who gets mixed up with a criminal gang that tries to frame him for a robbery.

Title: 252. The Quiet Gun
description: Sheriff Carl Brandon must uphold the law and prevent a lynching when his best friend is accused of murder and immorality by the townsfolk.

Title: 253. Street of Sinners
description: Rookie New York cop has to deal with juvenile delinquents, his superiors, and blame for the suicide of a woman who jumped to her death while he was in her apartment.

Title: 254. Quantez
description: Gang of robbers heads for Mexican border, meets unexpected opposition along the way.

Title: 255. Send a Woman When the Devil Fails
description: Henri Godot (Jean Servais) is the owner of a night-club in Paris. He hires young hit man Jo (Alain Delon) to kill his arch rival Boby. But Jo gets entangled with the intriguing femme fatale, Angele aka Maine (Edwige Feuillère), who is Bob's mistress.

Title: 256. Four Girls in Town
description: Which one of an international quartette of beauties will replace Universal's glamour star in an upcoming Biblical epic?

Title: 257. Speaking of Murder
description: A garage owner maintains his business as a front for his gang of criminals.

Title: 258. Lizzie
description: During the 1950s, a Los Angeles psychiatrist uses hypnosis to treat a 25-year-old woman who's suffering from multiple personality disorder.

Title: 259. The Ride Back
description: A troubled sheriff, a failure at everything in his life, tries to redeem himself by extraditing a popular gunfighter from Mexico to stand trial for murder.

Title: 260. The Rising of the Moon
description: Three vignettes of old Irish country life, based on a series of short stories.

Title: 261. It Happened in Rome
description: Three girls are on a hitchhiking trip through northern Italy, the riviera, Venice, Pisa and Rome.

Title: 262. Oedipus Rex
description: A kingdom faces divine punishment until its former king's killer is caught. The situation spells trouble for King Oedipus and his Queen.

Title: 263. Bombers B-52
description: Sgt. Chuck Brennan always disliked playboy and hotshot, Col. Jim Herlihy. Now Chuck has even more reason to - Jim is dating his daughter, Lois.

Title: 265. The Restless Breed
description: A very bright young lawyer with a very quick temper travels to Mission, a small Texas border town to even the score for the murder of his father, a secret service operator, at the hands of gun runners.

Title: 266. Plunder Road
description: Five men rob a train in Utah of 10 million dollars in gold and head to Los Angeles in 3 trucks hoping to meet up with their beautiful accomplice and leave the country.

Title: 267. The Body Snatcher
description: A wrestler and a detective team up to stop a mad scientist who is kidnapping athletes and replacing their brains with those of animals to make them stronger and live longer.

Title: 268. The Spies
description: Short of cash for his private clinic, a French psychiatrist accepts money from a NATO Intelligence agent to shelter a defecting Soviet-bloc scientist but enemy spies are closing-in.

Title: 269. I Am Waiting
description: A former boxer gets involved with a club hostess trying to escape the clutches of her gangster employer.

Title: 270. Drango
description: A Union officer oversees a town he destroyed on Sherman's march.

Title: 271. Lady of Vengeance
description: A man hires a killer to avenge an innocent girl's death.

Title: 272. Top Secret Affair
description: Unhappy about the appointment of an army general to the chairmanship of an atomic energy committee, a publishing empire female tycoon invites the general to her country estate in an effort to entrap him and ruin his reputation.

Title: 273. Fools in the Mountains
description: At a high mountain hotel in Norway the porter Poppe tries to do the best he can for the guests with an often unhelpful piccolo Rudolf. This, however, leads to a lot of problems, and Poppe thinks some of the guests behave inappropriate.

Title: 274. Lost Lagoon
description: A married castaway opens a resort with another woman.

Title: 275. Eighteen and Anxious
description: A naive teenager gets pregnant and is forced to face the realities of life.

Title: 276. The Deerslayer
description: In colonial America, wanderer Deerslayer gets involved with Tom Hutter, a bigoted trapper, and his two contrasting daughters.

Title: 277. Teenage Monster
description: In 1880 a young boy is exposed to the effects of a meteor and becomes an ugly killer monster, as his mother hides him in her new house and tries to stop his killing.

Title: 278. Count Five and Die
description: American and British counter-espionage combine to convince the Germans the cross-channel invasion will be in the Netherlands instead of France.

Title: 279. La grande strada azzurra
description: Squarciò, a fisherman, lives with his family on a small island off the Dalmatian coast of Italy. Like his fellow villagers, Squarciò struggles against harsh living conditions, a scarcity of fish in nearby waters and exploitation by the local wholesaler. But while the other fishermen continue to use nets, he goes out to the open sea to fish illegally with bombs. But Squarciò borrows money, loses his boat, and in a moment of supreme desperation, has to bomb directly off-shore, causing the hatred and rejection of his fellow fishermen. Trying to save his family, Squarciò and his young sons sail their new boat out beyond the local waters and bomb-fish again. But this time, the sea exacts a terrible toll...

Title: 280. Vysota
description: A team of installers under the leadership of brigadier Nikolai Pasechnik are arriving for the construction of the blast furnace. At the construction site, Nikolai meets welder Ekaterina. He tries to care for her, but they often quarrel.

Title: 282. Dragstrip Girl
description: Girl loves hot cars and a rich dragstrip racer. Her parents don't like either one.

Title: 283. Voodoo Woman
description: Deep in the jungles a mad scientist is using the natives' voodoo for his experiments to create an indestructible being to serve his will. When a party of gold seekers stumbles upon his village, the scientist realizes that Marilyn the expedition's evil leader is the perfect subject for his work.

Title: 284. Bayou
description: A visiting architect from New York named Martin Davis meets a Cajun beauty named Marie, who lives in a remote village somewhere in the Louisiana bayou.

Title: 285. Young and Dangerous
description: Tommy Price (Mark Damon) is the leader of a gang of young thugs interested in thrills, hot rods, and girls. His friends bet him he can't make it with 17-year-old Rosemary Clinton (Lili Gentle). Their date turns out badly and her parents (Dabbs Greer, Ann Doran) forbid her to see him again. They keep meeting, and the relationship changes him to the extent that he plans to go to college and change his life, which delights his parents (Eddie Binns, Frances Mercer).

Title: 286. The Circle
description: After Dr. Howard Latimer finds the German actress that he had just met at London Airport murdered in his flat, it leads him into a world of murder, blackmail and a fake passport scam.

Title: 287. Windom's Way
description: A doctor's wife joins him at his remote Asian practice to try and patch up their marriage. Increasingly violent friction between local rubber plantation workers and the authorities force both parties to make drastic decisions.

Title: 288. Rock All Night
description: Cloud Nine, the local teen hangout, has been taken over by a pair of escaped killers, who hold the local teens hostage. The bartender realizes it's up to him to save the kids.

Title: 289. The House of the Angel
description: The House of the Angel focuses on the ruling class in 1920s Argentina, a deeply repressive society where political arguments were often settled by duels, and young women were expected to be totally ignorant of sex.

Title: 290. The Flesh Is Weak
description: Pimps prey on young women coming to London for work.

Title: 291. The Living Idol
description: Several mysterious deaths are attributed to an ancient stone idol.

Title: 292. Don Kikhot
description: Senor Quexana has read so many books on chivalry that he believes that he is the knight Don Quixote de la Mancha. So Don Quixote sets off on his horse, accompanied by his squire Sancho Panza on a mule, to perform valiant deeds. They mistakenly save the Lady Altisidora who is so amused that she invites them to visit the Duke to provide some merriment at court. Among other deeds, Don Quixote frees some prisoners, who then turn upon him, and Don Quixote attacks a windmill that he imagines is a monstrous wizard.

Title: 293. Time Lock
description: A boy is accidentally locked in a bank vault. With less than ten hours of oxygen left in the vault, it becomes a race to save the boy.

Title: 294. The Lady Takes a Flyer
description: Husband and wife pilots Mike Dandridge and Maggie Colby try to balance their time and priorities between work and family life.

Title: 295. Stopover Tokyo
description: An American intelligence agent is sent to Tokyo to track down a Communist spy ring.

Title: 296. The Girl Most Likely
description: Dodie dreams of marrying a millionaire so that she can live 'the life'. Buzz, her boyfriend, however is not rich as he is a salesman for a housing development. He proposes and Dodie accepts. Dodie next meets Pete, who she thinks is rich, but she soon finds out that he is just a boat mechanic. They have fun on their date and Pete proposes and Dodie accepts. Then Dodie meets Neil Patterson who is rich. They go to Mexico on his yacht and have fun on their date. Neil proposes and Dodie accepts. Now she has to choose.

Title: 297. The Kettles on Old MacDonald's Farm
description: Ma and Pa do their bit to hook lumberman Brad Johnson up with spoiled socialite Sally Flemming. Ma teaches Sally how to behave like a hick so she'll be compatible with Brad.

Title: 298. Action of the Tiger
description: Carson is an American contraband runner approached by Tracy, a French woman who wants him to help rescue her brother from Albania where he is being held as a political prisoner.

Title: 299. The Iron Sheriff
description: When the sheriff's son is placed on trial for murdering a stagecoach driver, the sheriff desperately searches for the real killer - and finds the trail leads back to his boy.

Title: 300. The Young Stranger
description: After a 16-year-old, neglected by his movie producer father, gets in trouble, his father doesn't believe his claim of self-defense.

Title: 301. Pablo y Carolina
description: Carolina writes a love letter to a fictional man, but it reaches a real person. Complications arise when the recipient's boyfriend arrives seeking answers, and Carolina must maintain a false identity while developing feelings for him.

Title: 302. Seven Hills of Rome
description: A television star finds love while trying to get away from it all in Rome.

Title: 303. Il medico e lo stregone
description: Francesco, a young doctor, is appointed doctor to the imaginary village of Pianetta in the province of Avellino, but is immediately in competition with Don Antonio, a so-called "healer".

Title: 304. Decision Against Time
description: The efforts of test pilot John Mitchell to make a better life for his wife Mary and their two children seem doomed to failure and he blames himself.

Title: 305. Mister Cory
description: A street-smart young man from the Chicago slums dreams of cajoling with the rich and powerful, no matter the cost.

Title: 306. Nature Girl and the Slaver
description: Liane, the white jungle goddess, encounters some of her rich relatives from Hamburg who have come to search for her, but she is soon kidnapped by a ring of slave traders.

Title: 307. The Barretts of Wimpole Street
description: Elizabeth Barrett's tyrannical father has forbidden any of his family to marry. Nevertheless, Elizabeth falls in love with the poet Robert Browning.

Title: 308. Belle ma povere
description: Romulus and Salvatore are two Roman boys, engaged respectively with Anna Maria and Marisa, the first sister of Salvatore and the second of Romulus.

Title: 309. Der Stern von Afrika
description: Biographic Movie of the German fighter ace, who was killed in a plane crash after over 150 kills in North Africa.

Title: 310. The Crooked Circle
description: A young prizefighter finds himself being squeezed on all sides to throw a fight.

Title: 311. Campbell's Kingdom
description: Englishman Bruce Campbell (Dirk Bogarde) takes possession of his grandfather's Canadian land, but he faces various challenges such as disgruntled locals, a ruthless contractor, a new power dam, and his own bad health.

Title: 312. The Aztec Mummy
description: Experimenting in hypnotic regression to past lives, Dr. Almada discovers that his fiancée, Flor, is the reincarnation of an Aztec maiden who was put to death for loving an Aztec warrior, her body placed at the entrance to a hidden chamber in the Great Pyramid of Yucatan where the treasures of the Aztecs were hidden, and her lover mummified but cursed to remain alive and guard the treasure. With her recovered memories, Flor is able to lead Almada, his wimpish assistant Pincate, and her father to the now-skeletal remains of the maiden. Attached to them is a golden breastplate with a map detailing the route to the treasure. But to their horror, the party is intercepted by the mummified warrior, Popoca, and flee with the breastplate back to Mexico city. Popoca follows. In the meantime, Prof. Krup, an unscrupulous colleague of Almada's, recruits a gang of thugs, whom he leads from behind a mask and known only as "The Bat". Both Krup and his gang, and the mummy, converge on Flor's house to retrieve the sacred breastplate, which is in her possession...

Title: 313. The Mark of the Hawk
description: Obam finds himself caught in the middle of hostility between British colonists and African villagers who want to reclaim their land. He sets out to save his country before tensions get out of control.

Title: 314. Omar Khayyam
description: During the 11th century, Persian poet Omar Khayyam's lover marries the Shah but the Shah, whose life is threatened by a sect of assassins, appoints Omar royal advisor.

Title: 315. Like a Hair in the Soup
description: Pierre Cousin, a depressive compositor, wants to die. After five vain attempts at committing suicide, he decides to hire professional hit men to do the job on him.

Title: 316. Beau James
description: Biopic of the political career of Jimmy Walker, flamboyant and somewhat corrupt Mayor of New York City from 1926-1932.

Title: 317. Sun in the Last Days of the Shogunate
description: In the last days of the Shogunate, a resourceful grifter seeks to outwit competing prostitutes, rebellious samurai and other inhabitants of a brothel in order to survive the hardened times.

Title: 318. A Stranger in Town
description: In a sleepy village, a young composer is found shot dead and a woman is found gassed.

Title: 319. Valerie
description: After the American Civil War, former Union Major John Garth marries pretty settler Valerie but tragedy strikes and the two spouses end up in court where they give conflicting accounts of their marriage.

Title: 320. Monkey on My Back
description: The true story of Barney Ross, a World War II hero and champion professional boxer, who became addicted to morphine.

Title: 321. The Adventures of Arsène Lupin
description: Arsène Lupin, the gentleman thief with a hundred disguises, has just pulled off two burglaries in Paris when he is kidnapped. The ravishing Mina von Kraft, a German, has masterminded the deed for Emperor Wilhelm II.

Title: 322. Poor But Beautiful
description: Romolo and Salvatore are two young men who are neighbors and friends. They live with their parents in Piazza Navona in Rome. They are poor but handsome, and both fall in love with the beautiful Giovanna.

Title: 323. Gunsight Ridge
description: Stage line agent investigates a series of robberies by taking the job of a deputy sheriff in a border Arizona town.

Title: 324. Doroga k zvezdam
description: A groundbreaking popular science fiction film about the past and future of astronautics, from the first experiments by Konstantin Tsiolkovsky to the manned spaceflight and colonization of the Moon.

Title: 325. Thunderstorm
description: The Thunderstorm is a 1957 Hong Kong drama film directed by Ng Wui and starring Bruce Lee based on the play Thunderstorm by Chinese dramatist Cao Yu.

Title: 326. Naked in the Sun
description: During the 1830s white settlers are moving into what is now Florida. An unscrupulous slave trader captures the wife of Indian Chief Osceola, setting off a war between the Seminole tribe and the U.S Army.

Title: 327. The Fuzzy Pink Nightgown
description: After a movie star is kidnapped, everyone thinks it's a publicity stunt. It's not.

Title: 328. Interlude
description: A young American woman travels to Munich and falls in love with a famous German conductor, only to learn he has a mentally ill wife.

Title: 329. Cry of the Bewitched
description: Cuba, 1850. On a sugar-cane plantation, the master and his wife are happy: they are expecting a child, their slaves are quiet. But one night, as the full moon was rising, the sound of the drums blared in the air. Yambao, the grand-daughter of a sorceress killed 15 years ago, has come back - with her grand-mother's spirit.

Title: 330. Lissy
description: After the Nazis seized power in 1933, a vivacious working-class girl from Berlin realizes that escaping into a petty bourgeois marriage is not enough to preserve her decency and human dignity in these times.

Title: 331. Escapade in Japan
description: After a plane is forced to land at sea just off the Japanese coast, a young American boy is later befriended by a fisherman's son, with the two setting off on an unintended journey across the country.

Title: 332. Hidden Fear
description: When his sister is arrested in Denmark for murder, American cop Mike Brent aids Danish police with the case and stumbles upon a currency counterfeiting ring.

Title: 333. Confessions of Felix Krull
description: A charming, opportunistic young man climbs the social ladder in pre-WWI Europe by using his wits and elegance to deceive the elite. Felix Krull masters the art of reinvention, turning his life into a grand, sophisticated performance.

Title: 334. Man Afraid
description: A burglar is surprised by David and Lisa Collins in their son's room. In the struggle, Lisa's eyes are hurt and David throws an ornament, unintentionally killing the young thief. It's not easy for Reverend Collins to deal with the resulting publicity, his own conscience, or Lisa's temporary blindness. Meanwhile Carl Simmons, father of the dead burglar, begins to stalk the Collins' son Michael.

Title: 335. The Truth About Women
description: A man recalls his relationships with the women he loved as he tries to help another man understand them as well.

Title: 336. Hot Summer Night
description: An out-of-work journalist honeymooning in the Ozarks stumbles on a lead that a notorious bank robber is in town and tries to get his story.

Title: 337. The Vintage
description: Two Italian brothers flee to France and hide out in a vineyard with two sisters and their family.

Title: 338. City After Midnight
description: Sir Maurice Lawes witnesses a gendarme's murder on Rue des Anges, then dies the next night. Suspects: divorcée Eve Atwood, his thieving son Toby, or the burglar who killed the gendarme-a valuable necklace is missing.

Title: 339. Lovers of Paris
description: Young, handsome, dashing but cynical, Octave Mouret arrives in Paris, determined to conquer the belles of the capital. His first attempts are not too successful though as he is rebuffed by Valérie Vabre, the neurotic wife of the landlord of the block of flats he is accommodated in. As for the affair he starts with Caroline Hédouin, the married owner of "Au Bonheur des Dames", the shop where he works, the least we can say is that it lacks passion. But he does seduce Berthe, a girl he refused to marry when her mother tried to force her on him, now that she is married with another. He will finally achieve his end when Caroline, now widowed and needing a man to help her manage her business, asks him... to marry her!

Title: 340. Robbery Under Arms
description: Two brothers join their father in Captain Starlight's bush ranger gang in 19th Century Australia.

Title: 341. Appointment with a Shadow
description: George Nader plays a reporter whose career is ruined by liquor. A comeback opportunity presents itself when he is a bystander at the arrest of a well-known criminal.

Title: 342. The Ship Was Loaded
description: Two friends have a drunken reunion, where they dress in each other's clothes. They become mistaken for each other, and wind up having to assume these different identities. With resultant calamitous consequences, to both their careers.

Title: 343. Motorcycle Gang
description: A troublemaker returns to town and finds that his old tearaway pals have joined a supervised motorcycle club. Friction erupts between him and the new leader about this goody-goody setup--and the charms of gang moll Terry.

Title: 344. An Eye for an Eye
description: In North Africa Dr. Walter is a very skilled surgeon but lives at a distance from the hospital. In the evening a husband and his sick wife come to his private home from far away. He tells them to go to the hospital. The wife dies during the operation. The other doctors think that Walter might have saved her. Shortly afterward a man asks Walter to come to a village to treat a very sick man. Walter goes thither in his car. The local habitants do not allow him to apply Western medical techniques, all tyres of his car are stolen, and he sees husband in this village. Walter tells him that his wife would not have died if he had timely taken her to a doctor. Walter buys a lot of coca-cola and starts walking home on his feet. He refuses husband's offer to show him a shortcut. But thrice he finds husband sitting at the road much ahead of him. Then he accepts husband's guidance = misguidance. When they have been without water for many days and Walter wishes he was dead, he wounds husband with a knife. Husband is sure to die within 24 hours without medical treatment. Then husband says that inhabited areas are found in a quite different direction. Walter starts in this direction, not followed by husband.

Title: 345. The Girl in the Kremlin
description: In 1953, Soviet dictator Stalin fakes his own death, undergoes plastic surgery and vanishes but OSS agent Steve Anderson searches for him in Europe.

Title: 346. Nau Do Gyarah
description: Runaway wealthy heiress, Raksha, joins a traveller, Madan, in a small truck, heading toward the home of his uncle, Manoharlal. When they reach their destination, they are informed that Manoharlal has passed away, and the estate and all the wealth is taken over by his son, Kuldeep, and his mother. Madan is suspicious and starts making inquiries about this death. Soon he himself comes under suspicion, and with the help of Surjit, he is arrested and imprisoned by the police, on the charge of kidnapping Raksha. This gets him out of the way, so that the real culprits can get away with the wealth.

Title: 347. Demoniac
description: Gervais and his friend Bernard, two prisoners of war, manage to escape from the camp where they are held. Bernard is determined to take refuge with Hélène, his war grandmother, a woman with whom he has been carrying on a romance by correspondence and Gervais agrees to accompany him. Unfortunately, Bernard is killed by a train before they get to destination. Gervais then decides to present himself to Hélène who, never having seen Bernard, mistakes the newcomer for her war godson. Too weak to restore the truth, Gervais becomes Bernard and moves in with Hélène. The situation gets even more complicated as two more women get into Gervais'life and entangle him in their web, Agnès, Hélène's jealous sister, and Julia, Bernard's sister, who pretends to recognize him...

Title: 348. The Big Boodle
description: In pre-Castro Cuba, Ned Sherwood is caught between police and counterfeiters.

Title: 349. The Sad Sack
description: A bumbling hero with a photographic memory winds up in Morocco as a private in the French Foreign Legion. He still hasn't adjusted after 18 months. Among other things, he's lost a tank.

Title: 350. Guendalina
description: A teenage girl vacations in the Italian Riviera during the summer with her wealthy parents; as her parents bicker and contemplate divorce, the young girl finds love in the arms of a handsome student.

Title: 351. Black Patch
description: In a New Mexico town, two former pals from the Civil War meet again but one is the town marshal and the other is a wanted bank robber.

Title: 352. Värmlänningarna
description: Erik, the son of a wealthy farmer, and Anna, the daughter of a poor crofter, have known each other since they were children. Now, that they are grown up, they love each other, but their parents won't let them have each other, since their families are enemies. Erik's father wants him to marry a rich girl instead and when Anna hears about this, she falls ill and even starts to show signs of insanity. Will the two have each other or will everything go wrong?

Title: 353. Ferien auf Immenhof
description: The pony hotel has just been opened, but so far no guests have arrived. Dick gets Ralf to design a brochure about the hotel. The girls and Ethelbert then lead the village children on horseback to Lübeck, where they all distribute the brochure, not knowing that Dalli has added some embellishments to the text. An orphaned boy wins a two-week stay at the hotel. Luckily, paying guests are coming now, too. Most important among them is Dr. Westkamp, boss of a travel agency. Unfortunately, he keeps very much to himself. Quite unlike a certain Fräulein Gisela, who much to Dick's dislike seems to have set her cap upon Ralf. All is happily resolved when it turns out that Gisela is Westkamp's secretary. Westkamp offers Jochem a contract and Ralf a job; from now on, The Immenhof will no longer go without guests.

Title: 354. Pontianak
description: The story begins with Chomel discovering a spell that can turn it into a beautiful one. If she felt human blood, she would turn into a vampire.

Title: 355. Last of the Badmen
description: Chicago detectives in 1875 head west to find the killers of their colleague.

Title: 356. Dangerous Exile
description: During the French Revolution, a French nobleman saves the 10-year-old son of Louis XVI and Marie Antoinette from the guillotine with the help of an English woman.

Title: 357. Rio, Zona Norte
description: A talented songwriter of sambas is forced to face the social injustices of the city around him.

Title: 358. Man on the Tracks
description: In 1950, at night, a passenger train kills a man on the tracks. He is Orzechowski, an engineer since 1914. An inquiry immediately follows. Testimony takes the form of flashbacks. Tuszka, the station master, believes Orzechowski was a saboteur; at least one on the inquiry panel agrees. Zapora, the young engineer on the train that hit Orzechowski, gives more complicated testimony about the dead man - stiff-necked, proud, imperious, critical of Zapora and other younger workers. The signalman at the crossing where Orzechowski died also testifies. Can the panel arrive at the truth in a world where workers unite, inferior coal is a badge of honor, and the old order is suspect?

Title: 359. Hell Canyon Outlaws
description: Efficient Sheriff Caleb Wells is fired by the short-sighted town council, thus clearing the way for a group of hoodlums to vandalize the peaceful and defenseless town.

Title: 360. Far till sol och vår
description: Martin Wide inherits a bus from his dying grandfather. He restores it from being a hen house into a tourist bus. He puts an ad in the newspaper about "travels to the sun" and also advertises for a stewardess at the same time. The female reporter Vera Boman signs up for the job, in order to expose the "tourist travel hoax". The two, together with passengers of various kinds set off from a snowy Sweden towards Paris. During the trip, Vera starts to realize that Martin is not a "tourist cheater" but a kind and thoughtful travel arranger, who tries to tend to all his passengers as best as he can, even when the situations become difficult to handle. In addition, a famous Swedish diamond has just been stolen and it turns out that both the thieves and the private detectives who are after them, are passengers on the bus.

Title: 361. Ek Jhalak
description: It is about the radha soami ji live cycle and their guru shiksha it is a wonderful movie

Title: 362. The Book of Acts Series
description: The Book of Acts is a 10-part series of short Bible films dramatizing the 28 chapters that comprise the Acts of the Apostles. The series was produced in 1957 by Family Films on behalf of Broadman Films, based in Nashville, Tennessee.

Title: 363. Blonde in Bondage
description: American reporter doing a story on Swedish nightlife gets involved with a drug-addicted nightclub singer.
