description: A recently widowed woman hires a struggling P.I. to spend some time with her stepdaughter, still distraught over her wealthy father's fatal horse-riding accident. He comes to believe it was no accident, and resolves to identify the killer.

Title: 659. Kill Me Tomorrow
description: A boozy old reporter finds his life is falling apart around him. He loses his wife and then his job. He is dragged back to reality when his son needs help. He goes to ask for his old job back but finds his old boss dead in the office ...

Title: 660. Night Butterflies
description: A traditional bar mistress in Kyoto clashes with her Tokyo rival.

Title: 661. La peau de l'ours
description: Commissioner Ledru works in Saint-Germain, a quiet town in the Paris suburbs. A town that is too quiet, where nothing ever happens. He consoles himself by growing roses. But he feels like he is stuck in a rut. Until the day he discovers that someone is poisoning him with arsenic. He begins to suspect everyone: his wife, a second wife much younger than him. His children from a first marriage, his son, who borrows money from everyone around him. His daughter, who wants to marry a young engineer. And one of his friends, a doctor, who is a little too close to his wife. Finally, his mother-in-law, who lives with him and exasperates him with her insistence that he have a child with her daughter. The commissioner becomes paranoid. He only eats and drinks food that he keeps in a safe. Will this paranoia end up destroying his family? Jean Richard masterfully directs this lively dramatic comedy.

Title: 662. Maravilla
description: A famous artist is willing to return to her home country where she left her daughter as a child.

Title: 663. Arrivano i dollari!
description: A widow goes to Italy from South Africa to find out whether or not her late husband's five nephews are worthy of his inheritance. She poses as the lawyer who wrote the will and lets the real lawyer pass for herself. This way she will be able to discover the five men's vices and faults.

Title: 664. La finestra sul Luna Park
description: A man has problems connecting with his son after coming home from work in Africa, after his wife's death.

Title: 665. Rock Around the World
description: This is the story of the early life and rise to fame of Tommy Steele. His manager wanted him to be a tough rock'n'roller and so challenge Elvis Presley but Tommy is too nice. He becomes famous anyway!!

Title: 667. God Is My Partner
description: Dr. Charles Grayson, a respected surgeon, retires and starts to give away large portions of his savings to religious causes. His immediate family launches a suit against him, declaring him incapable of handing his money. He is brought to trial and a niece, Frances Denning, acts as his defense partner. Her witnesses - some former patients - persuade the judge that since the surgeon believes his skills and success came as a result of divine intervention, he has the right to donate his money as he sees fit.

Title: 668. Said effendi
description: The story revolves around the teacher "Saeed" who moves from house to house, until he lives in the house of "Ezzat" the shoemaker next door to him and the falsehood of the neighborhood people who harbor bad and pretend love and notices the signs of neglect that fill the neighborhood, and the owner of the house asks "Saeed" to leave the house So, the people of the neighborhood refuse to leave "Saeed" home and leave, and join hands against the owner of the house, so the son of "Saeed" is injured in a quarrel with the children of "Ezzat" and seeks revenge on him.

Title: 671. Kara talih
description: A woman who has a bad reputation in her village, migrates the city and tries to find herself among hookers in the back streets.

Title: 672. Secuestro diabolico
description: Second film in the Tigres del ring series.

Title: 673. Hell Ship Mutiny
description: Jim Knight is the captain of a ship trading in the South Seas. He runs into trouble when he makes port at an island where crooks Malone and Ross hold the natives under their cruel domination while they seek a fortune in pearls. Knight and his crew are taken prisoners and he falls for native princess Mareva, and her non-plump charms are more than enough motivation for Knight to put an end to Malone and his henchmen, and also the the greedy police commissioner Lamoret.

Title: 675. Made in Germany - Die dramatische Geschichte des Hauses Zeiss
678. Man on the Prowl
description: Psycho/slasher/sex maniac stalks a young woman.

Title: 679. Ride a Violent Mile
description: Cowhand Jeff Donner meets Susan Crowley, a spy for the Union in the Civil War, and gets dragged into her espionage ring that is out to foil the South's attempts to break the blockade keeping them from obtaining food and supplies. The trek leads to Mexico.

Title: 680. Courage of Black Beauty
description: After some hesitation, 10-year-old Bobby accepts the gift of a magnificent black foal from his severe, thoughtless and overprotective father.

Title: 681. Spielbank-Affäre
description: In a casino in a West German health resort, one often sees Sybille - an attractive young student actress. With her winnings from the roulette table, she attempts to finance her studies. Despite a rather lucky streak, her winnings are a little on the lean side. She doesn't, however, gamble with her own money but with that of Dr. Busch, a lawyer, who likes to stay in the background with the argument that gambling houses are not the proper turf for a serious lawyer. From him, Sybille receives only a small share of her winnings later, and only through the intervention of Gerhard Fischer, a journalist, does Sybille come to realize her role in Dr. Busch's fraudulent scheme. Dr. Busch uses her to bring bogus chips in circulation, he wants to ruin the casino and eventually bring it under the control of a monopoly The journalist's attempt to make the deception known proves ultimately to be unsuccessful - the casino bosses have already informed each other and taken the appropriate steps. Nevertheless, Fischer and Sybille become a couple.

Title: 683. The Surgeon's Knife
description: When his patient dies during an operation, a surgeon resorts to murder to cover up his negligence.

Title: 684. Young Girls Beware
description: When Raven gets out of prison after serving five years on a frame-up by gang-leader Mendetta, he kills Mendetta deciding to take over in his place. He is seen leaving the apartment by Dany Dumont, wife of a neighbor.When two of the dead-man's henchmen learn she was a witness, they abduct her, hoping to blackmail Reven when the opportunity arises. To ensure she is around when needed, they keep her in a house of prostitution.

Title: 685. No Sun in Venice
description: In Venice, a French agent tries to recover printing plates, used to print fake currency, from an ex-Nazi who stole them during WW2.

Title: 687. Paris Music Hall
description: The publicist Henri Michelin is looking for a new star for the review of Eden, a music hall led by Bendix.

Title: 688. That Night!
description: Chris works at an agency writing TV commercials. One day on his train commute, he suffers a heart attack. Chris and his wife vow to reconsider what is important to them after he is released from the hospital.

Title: 689. Gun Duel in Durango
description: Ex-outlaw Will Sabre wants an honest life under the alias Dan Tomlinson but his old gang, under new leader Dunsten, wants him back for a new string of armed robberies.

Title: 690. Sword in the Moonlight
description: Tsukue Ryunosuke is a master swordsman with an evil style, reflecting the evil in his heart.

Title: 691. Syostry
description: Historical drama, the first part of a three-part film to the novel by Alexei Tolstoy "Walking through the agony."

Title: 692. Duel at Apache Wells
description: A young man returns home after several years' absence to find that a gang is after not only his family ranch, but his girlfriend as well.

Title: 693. Rockabilly Baby
description: The mysterious Mrs. Eleanor Carter moves to Springfield with her two teenagers, Jimmy and Cathy. Eleanor makes friends with the town's social leader, Mrs. Wellington, who supports her idea of a town youth center, and she is aided by Tom Griffith, the high school principal. At the town's annual picnic, to which Eleanor has bought a band (Les Brown and His Band of Reknown), the town busybody, Eunice, reveals what she learned about Eleanor's past.

Title: 694. Johnny Walker
description: Chronicling the comedic escapades of Bombay-based alcoholic Murli Manohar as he uses a forged document to secure employment; falls in love with, Chandra Kripalani, the Manager's Secretary; then fools her into believing that he is an abstainer, and the real alcoholic is his elder brother. He subsequently loses his job, but Chandra does not give up on him - she not only arranges an introduction with her Poona-based dad, Mangaldas, but also finds employment for him in Indore - not realizing that soon he will be arrested for violating Prohibition Legislation, as well as assaulting her in public.

Title: 695. ¡Cielito lindo!
description: Revolutionist and Army General compete for a beautiful woman.

Title: 696. Çölde bir Istanbul kizi
description: The love story between a fugitive and a governor's daughter set in Arabia.

Title: 697. Amanecer en Puerta Oscura
description: Set in rural South of Spain in the 19th century, tells the story of group of outlaws, from very different origins, trying to survive, hiding from the law enforcement officers in caves in a hilly area, and their struggle against the evil mining company that exploits the poor people of their home village.

Title: 698. Das Herz von St. Pauli
description: In Hamburg, the ex-captain Jonny Jensen runs the bar "Das Herz von St. Pauli". Business is not going well. Jensen is forced to enroll the shade "Jabo" Jabowski as a business partner. Jabo brings in contraband and store it in the cellar, he renovates the bar area and turns into a nightclub with young girls performing.

Title: 699. The Hired Gun
description: A woman breaks out of jail before her hanging and a man is hired to bring her back.

Title: 700. Ibo kyoudai
description: In a military family, an illegitimate son is brutalized by his brothers. A patriarchal, feudalistic household where dissent is forbidden is used to reveal the whole imperialist system that afflicted Japan between 1921 and 1946.

Title: 701. Five Clues to Fortune
description: A treasure has been hidden at Woburn Abbey at the time of the Dissolution of the Monasteries. When the sale of the present-day estate is threatened three children find this treasure by means of five clues hidden in a deer's antler.

Title: 703. Mamma tar semester
description: Sylvia returns to Sweden after having lived abroad for six years. She visits her sister Karin, and is shocked to see how her husband and children regard her as a live-in housekeeper. She convinces Karin to take a vacation with her in Stockholm.

Title: 704. Pudumaipithan
description: Pudumai Pithan is a 1957 Indian Tamil film, directed by T R Ramanna produced by Sivakami Pictures. The film stars MGR and Sarojadevi in lead roles. Music of the film was composed by G Ramanathan.

Title: 708. Pathey Holo Deri
description: A doctor falls in love with the granddaughter of a rich man. She helps him to pursue his dream of higher education by giving him her mother's jewellery to sell. The fate of the two lovers after the doctor's return is not a sweet one as the woman's grandfather plans a sinister move.

Title: 709. Il corsaro della mezzaluna
description: 16th century pirate Paolo, in the guise of a poet, enters a castle hoping to find his parents' murderer. He kidnaps Angela, thinking she is Emperor Charles V's sister Caterina. A battle ensues with evil Carmona who wants to marry Angela.

Title: 710. Madrugada
description: A rich and famous painter dies leaving a secret that kept him apart from the woman he loved. Suspecting a family plot, she will try to unveil it keeping his death from the greedy relatives who are called in the middle of the night. She will try to find the truth before the dawn comes at last.

Title: 711. Violent Stranger
description: A woman's husband has been convicted of murder. Knowing he is innocent, she sets out to find the real killer.

Title: 712. Les lavandières du Portugal
description: Jean-François and his friend Catherine both work in an advertising agency where a juicy contract with the Floc washing-machine is to be signed. But they quarrel and separate. Catherine joins a competing house while Jean-François goes on working on the Floc file. One day, the young man has a stroke of genius in deciding to tie in the Floc machine with the hit song "Les lavandières du Portugal" (The Washerwomen of Portugal)...

Title: 713. Peter van Heeren
description: The rich, eccentric but lovable detective Peter van Heeren and his helpful butler is persuaded to help a friend, Kathie Winter, who is blackmailed by a lawyer, while the lawyer also tries to win her love.

Title: 715. Ek Saal
description: The father of a dying woman pays a con artist to make his daughter's final year a happy one.

Title: 716. Strangers' Meeting
description: An acrobat, convicted of murder, escapes from Dartmoor to prove his innocence. Despite being shot in the leg he reaches a London pub where he convinces a friend to shelter him.

Title: 717. The Crooked Sky
description: An American detective unmasks a gambler as the head of a banknote counterfeiting gang.

Title: 719. Muertos de risa
description: Carnival worker is recruited by police to impersonate an old lady whose relatives want to kill her.

Title: 720. Woman and the Hunter
description: The machinations of a young adventuress while fortune hunting in darkest Africa.

Title: 721. La sombra del otro
description: Víctor Gómez has always been under the shadow of his dead brother, whom his mother always idolizes and compares with him. Victor will have to find a way to make a living by boxing and earns the respect of his mother. El Pajarito, Viruta and Capulina will give him encouragement.

Title: 723. The Storm Rider
description: Smaller ranchers hire a gunman (Scott Brady) to lead them against the big ranchers.

Title: 724. Hot Rod Rumble
description: Arny joins a hot rod club, but his eccentric mannerisms (a Marlon Brando rip-off performance from "The Wild One" by look-alike Hartunian) make him unpopular. At a party, Terry rebukes him for his coarseness and centers her attention on another boy. A fight between the two men is stopped by Jim Lawrence, but Ray Johnson, pretending friendship with Arny, keeps the antagonism going and tries to win Terry for himself. Driving home, Hank and Terry are harassed by a hot rod which they think is driver by Arny. Swerving to avoid a collision, they are thrown from the car, and Hank is killed and Terry badly injured and unconscious. Ray, the actual driver of the hot rod, carries Terry to his car, but frightened by approaching vehicles, he returns her to the wreckage and flees. All, including Terry, blame Arny for the wreck, but there is no proof. Vindictive club members destroy Arny's car and beat him mercilessly. He rebuild his car for the big race. Terry goes to the race with Ray and, in his car she finds an earring she lost in the accident and realizes it was Ray who drove the fatal car. Arny wins the race, sour disposition and all, wins the race and Terry forces Ray to admit the truth about the wreck.

Title: 725. Maria Pentagiotissa
description: The hopeless love between Maria Pentagiotissa and a man belonging to a different social class.

Title: 726. Tropicana
description: A business man tries to save a cabaret club from ruin but ends up in jail because of his debts. Also, he marries a beautiful younger woman and afterwards thinks he made a mistake but later realizes that she really is the woman of his dreams and finds happiness with her.

Title: 727. Il cocco di mamma
description: Aldo, Vasco and "Smilzo" (Slim) are friends. They live with their parents and are training for boxing. But their real interest is in women. When casually Aldo meets Laura and falls for her. Will he succeed in winning her love?

Title: 728. Approaches to the Psychology of Personality: Film No. 6 - Personality Organization: Fundamental Concepts
description: Richard I. Evans from the University of Houston interviews Carl Gustav Jung on the subjects of the persona, introversion and extroversion, intuition and the work of J.B. Rhine.

Title: 730. Last Stagecoach West
description: The coming of the railroad to Cedar City spells the end of the stagecoach as the government gives the mail contract to the fastest means of delivery. McCord loses the stagecoach line gambling with the new buyer, but has enough hidden money to buy a ranch and some cattle. To make more money, he starts a gang to rob the railroad, express offices and steal cattle. But the railroads send out special agent Cameron to end his reign of violence.

Title: 731. La garçonne
description: Monique is an ingenue, a clueless girl who believes in true love, for her fiancé is a handsome man, and at the time (early 20th century), marriage is the only thing a decent girl must long for. When she discovers that her future husband has a lover, she rebels against her bourgeois family and their money math; she will live a wild, free life--she will live like a man. Soon she becomes the toast of the Gai Paris, sleeping with all the men--and even a woman.

Title: 732. Lagoon of Desire
description: A rich and spoiled daughter of a businessman seduces a charming fisherman, upsetting his life and his relationship with the woman he loved and was about to marry.

Title: 733. Oregon Passage
description: An army officer tries to help the Indians placed in his charge, but finds himself interfering with their way of life.

Title: 734. The Badge of Marshal Brennan
description: A pseudo-marshal, a local doctor and the town sheriff must join forces to battle a greedy cattle-baron whose herd, locally sold, is contaminated with a contagious disease.

Title: 735. Times of Joy and Sorrow
description: Covering the years from 1932 through 1957, this is the story of the trials and tribulations of lighthouse keeper Shiro and his wife Kiyoko.

Title: 736. Spanish Affair
description: An American architect traveling in Madrid falls in love with his interpreter but is faced by a jealous lover who follows them.

Title: 737. A Bomb for a Dictator
description: A revolution breaks out in a South American country while its cruel dictator is on a trip to France. The rebels have made careful plans to blow up the dictator's private plane as he returns, but at the last second he changes plans and travels on a commercial flight. The rebels then must make a difficult decision: they must either blow up a flight filled with innocent passengers, or else allow the dictator to return home and take brutal reprisals against the leaders of the uprising.

Title: 738. Kindermädchen für Papa gesucht
description: Ladykiller Peter hires a pretty nanny to present to his unlucky in love nephew Kurt. Then they go out to find a child she can look after.

Title: 739. The Lawless Eighties
description: An outlaw gang tries to grab the land of the Sioux Indians, but a pair of cowboys seeks to thwart their plans. Based on Alson Jesse Simth's biography "Brother Van."

Title: 741. Urok istorii
description: Georgi Dimitrov is on his way to Berlin, which is controlled by the Nazis. Hitler, Gyobbels and Gyoring plan the Reichstag fire. Van der Lube sets the Reichstag on fire. This triggers off a wave of arrests. The Communists have to go underground. Dimitrov is arrested. The German consul in Bulgaria refuses to receive his mother. She leaves for Germany. All over Europe, signatures are gathered in support of the detainees. At the court hearings, Dimitrov exposes the provocative policy of the Nazi government. Gyoring takes the witness stand. His speech on the grand future in store for Nazism is intermingled with actuality sequences from the World War II: victims, executions, death camps... Dimitrov is granted Soviet citizenship and leaves the fascist jail.

Title: 742. Outlaw Queen
description: Christina, the daughter of a Greek-immigrant family who does not share their belief that a woman's place is with her husband at the fireside, is a trick-shot artist, and with her Uncle Jim, a strolling troubadour, and his sidekick Andy, a mandolin player, heads west to make her fortune. Conway, owner of the saloon in a dusty frontier town hires them as performers. Later, she cleans him out in a poker game, with the aid of Uncle Jim calling out Conway's cards in Greek in a song. Chris opens up her own gambling palace, and sends Uncle Jim out looking for a cattle ranch to buy. Conway sends some henchmen over to shoot up her place and she kills one of them in a gun-battle. Meanwhile, out on the open range, Uncle Jim meets Rick Mason, a trail boss for a large herd heading for Dodge City. Chris buys the herd and hires Rick as a foreman of her newly-acquired ranch. Then John Andrews, a mining engineer from her past, comes to town. And Conway is still working for vengeance against her.

Title: 743. Kean: Genius or Scoundrel
description: Edmund Kean is a popular British actor and theatrical nineteenth addicted to vices, however, and in debt. He contends with the Prince of Wales, his companion of excesses, the Danish ambassador's wife, but eventually falls in love with Anna, a young but promising rookie actress.

Title: 744. Gejagt bis zum Morgen
description: Fate of a working-class family on the threshold of the 20th century. After her husband died at work, Martha Kurda was left alone with two children. Thirteen-year-old Ludwig becomes the breadwinner of the family.

Title: 745. Yagyû bugeichô
description: In the Tokugawa Era, the clan of Lord Yagyu has hidden away three scrolls containing clan secrets which, if revealed, would cause revolution and disaster for the clan. The information is divided among the three scrolls, all of which must be possessed for the secrets to be understood. When Princess Yuhime steals the scrolls, Tasaburo, a samurai with magical powers, and his brother Senshiro are sent to retrieve them.

Title: 746. Danger Stalks Near
description: Three criminals planning to rob a house are continually delayed by the families antics.

Title: 747. À pied, à cheval et en voiture
description: When he learns that his daughter is to be engaged to the son of a rich businessman, Leon Martin realizes that extreme measures are needed to create a good impression.

Title: 748. The Parson and the Outlaw
description: Billy the Kid tries to live in peace, under a new name and in a frontier town, but is approached by a preacher who asks for his help in freeing the town from a ruthless man and his gunman.

Title: 749. The Bolshoi Ballet
description: Paul Czinner filmed, using multiple camera techniques, the performance of prima ballerina Galina Ulanova of the Russian Bolshoi, performing "Giselle" while the troupe was on tour in England in 1956.

Title: 750. Die Frühreifen
description: Inge, a saleswoman, dreams of escaping her cramped life. Selected to model in a store fashion show, she gains confidence. Her boyfriend surprises her with a motorcycle, but she's drawn to wealthy Günther's party invitation.

Title: 751. Hell on Devil's Island
description: Corrupt prison authorities use convict labor to run mines.

Title: 752. Aaravalli
description: Aaravalli is a women-oriented story. Aaravalli is the name of Queen who rules on Men. The story is set in the kingdom of Nellurupattinam of which the title character Aaravalli (G. Varalakshmi) and her sister Sooravalli (S. Mohana) are disputed rulers. The story in fact refers to seven sisters, but the reins of control were in the hands of these two women Aravalli and Sooravalli, who are described as magician. Bheema offers to conquer them. But Bheema (Thirupathisamy) faces defeat at the hands of these two women, who utterly humiliate him and send to prison. But he escape from prison. Then, Sooravalli visits Indraprasta and she complains to King Dharma (K. Nadarajan) for his brother Bheema and Dharma send back his brother for nelluru pattinam. The astrologer skill Sahadevan to formulated a master plan against the two cunning women. The plan is their nephew Alli muthu (S. G. Eswar) the son of their Sister Sangavathy (M. S. Draupadi), for the specific purpose of taking challenged posed sisters on behalf Pandavas. So, Alli Muthu and his companion named as Arayathi (Kaka Radhakrishnan) arrival to Nelluru Pattinam Kingdom. After long travel, their spent few hours for rest and Vainsh hungry and thirsty. Alli Muthu was got some rarity herbal nearby the water pond and their kept at it. Finally, their come to Nelluru pattinam and meets the magician's Queens and her posed three challenge to him. And alli Muthu accepts three challenges. alli Muthu meets Aaravalli's daughter alangaravalli (Mynavathi) at palace his impressed with her. Alangavalli and Alli Muthu fall in love. Then Alli Muthu faced three challenges and victory end of this challenge to help of dominate queen daughter Alangaravalli. As a sign of their submission the two queens offers their daughter alangaravalli in married to victory. The newly wedded couple and Arayathi arrives to Indraprasta Kingdom. The pair make their way into forest where the bride in her innocence follows the instruction of her mother and g

Title: 753. Der König der Bernina
description: Nach zehn Jahren kehrt Markus Paltram in sein altes Heimatdorf zurück.

Title: 755. Miss Mary
description: R.K. Raju, a private investigator is assigned the task of locating the missing daughter of a wealthy Hindu couple. His investigation take him to different locales, and he comes across Miss Mary, the girl closely resembling the one he is looking for. He asks her to accompany him, in the guise of teaching his girlfriend some music, to which she agrees. On the way there, they meet with Arun, who also agrees to accompany them as Miss Mary's husband. Once there Miss Mary is informed that she is the daughter of the Hindu couple, and she strongly denies this, stating that she is born a Christian, lived with a Christina Priest all her life, and has no knowledge of being a Hindu. Then a stolen locket of Devi Maa Laxmi is located, and the suspect, prima facie, is Mary and a gentleman, who claims to be her bethrothed.

Title: 756. Éjfélkor
description: On New Year's Eve in 1956, the artist couple, the actor János and the dancer Viki, are hastily packing. While they are waiting for the car, which is to take them across the border, their entire life is replayed in front of their eyes.

Title: 757. Toggar el mawt
description: A gang led by a doctor who selects some desperate men and persuade them to marry and edit the insurance policy on the life of the wives and then killed .

Title: 758. Menace in the Night
description: A woman witnesses the theft of soiled banknotes from a mail delivery truck, then is threatened by the perpetrators of the crime.

Title: 759. The Black Devil
description: Duke Ubaldo of (fictitious) Roccamontana wants to overpower neighboring Italian states by concluding an alliance with the mighty Spaniards. The barons of his council are frightened or bribed to agree, except two. The old count of Archidosso is killed, his daughter Laura told her hand was promised to the duke. The other, count Riccardo d'Argentari, is beaten up and thrown in the river, presumed dead. But friends save him, so he can become the masked 'black captain' of a rebellion movement. Ubaldo's equally ruthless mistress, donna Violenta, is courteously kidnapped while bringing a message to the Spanish commander, don Diego Espinosa, which the rebels manage to substitute. She maintains an earlier pretense to be on Riccardo's side. When that fails, the tyrant couple kidnaps and tortures Laura.

Title: 760. Malwa
description: The story of rivalry between father and son over the love of one woman. Once upon a time, the peasant Vasily left his native village, leaving his wife and son Yakov. He worked for many years in the fishing industry, where, forgetting about his family, he became friends with the beautiful fisherman Malva and lived a serene life. But the grown-up son came to his father. Soon the relationship between him and Malva led to conflicts with his father.

Title: 761. Immer wenn der Tag beginnt
description: Dr. Hanna Burkhardt is a passionate teacher, who is a cause of some of the necessary changes at the strict school where she teaches. Martin Wieland, a student, falls in love with her, the personification of an unattainable wish.

Title: 762. The Story of Liubao
description: About the love of a young commander of the People's Liberation Army and a girl from the village of Liubao, how the landowner wanted to marry her for a Kuomintang man and how the commander saved his beloved from this marriage.

Title: 765. Sin Alley
description: Desperation has a good hold of the youngsters. There are no more than 30,000 teacherships. Young people from the province are flowing to Copenhagen in the hope that the possibilities are greater there.

Title: 766. Dendam Pontianak
description: The vampire comes back for revenge.

Title: 767. Rico Ri à Toa
description: Taxi driver gets in a jam when he receives a lot of money as inheritance from a distant family member when in fact, the money came from a bank robbery.

Title: 768. Cinco gallinas y el cielo
description: One night, a thief steals five chickens to sell it. This is a particular because those animals have an special component that will bring audacity to anyone who eats its flesh.

Title: 769. Skandal in Ischl
description: A gynecologist is suspected of sexual harassment to his customers, and ostracized in the luxury beach village of Ischl. When even his wife falls in another man's arms, he will prove his rectitude - a trifle too late.

Title: 770. Meiyou wancheng de xiju
description: Two well-known comedians perform in three satirical short films for a group of party cadres, where the two comics allegorically parody party propaganda and ideological orthodoxy.

Title: 772. Hrátky s certem
description: Brave soldier goes to Hell to save the souls of a beautiful princess and her maid.

Title: 773. Escape from San Quentin
description: An escaped convict decides to quit running and turn himself and his fellow escapee in to the authorities - but not without complications.

Title: 774. Sønnen fra Amerika
description: Danish film from 1957. The son Jens runs Seat from Home and returns after 20 years. Reunits with old friends. Not all finds themselves happy about Jens's return, that brings new things and changes to the villiage.

Title: 775. Action immédiate
description: The secret blueprints are stolen from national security. French secret service agent Walder believes that the documents are now in Switzerland, in the hands of a man named Lindbaum.

Title: 776. Gunfire at Indian Gap
description: A Thrilling and Romantic Story of the Great West!

Title: 777. Nachts im grünen Kakadu
description: Conservative dancing instructor Irene fears her school will be impounded. To raise cash she reluctantly agrees to manage a notorious night club she might inherit. Will the very attentive Dr. Maybach be a suitable business partner for her?

Title: 779. Do Roti
description: An unemployed school-teacher experiences life-changing problems when he speaks out against his dishonest brother-in-law.

Title: 780. Nesaa Fi Hayati
description: Ahmed Awad, a self-made carpenter who owns a workshop, loves Touha, a girl from his neighborhood but she doesn't feel the same. He loses everything after a fire burns down his workshop. Ahmed meets Sana in the hospital after being injured in the fire. At the same time, Nana and Sana love him deeply.

Title: 781. Sette canzoni per sette sorelle
description: The mayor of a provincial town has seven daughters who spend their days listening to Claudio Villa's records.

Title: 783. Trois jours à vivre
description: Simon Belin is an actor touring the provinces with his company. Although talented he has never been given the opportunity to shine on stage. It is always Bérimont, a matinée idol past his best, who gets the lead roles. One day however, Simon is witness to a murder. Subjected to the pressure of justice, of his agent and of his own wish for publicity, he identifies a suspect, Ferrari, without being certain he is the real culprit. Singled out by his action he becomes the toast of the town.Overnight he replaces Bérimont as the star of the play. But Ferrari, who had been sentenced to twenty years in prison, escapes and threatens him ; from now on he has ... three days to live.

Title: 784. Saturday Night
description: The first omnibus film made in Yugoslavia, tells the three stories set in Belgrade by night - a loving couple, a desperate boxing handler, and troubles of contemporary youth.

Title: 785. A csodacsatár
description: Mail author for translation. Futbólia minisztertanácsa ehatározza, hogy megszerzi az ország- nak a világhírû magyar csodacsatárt. Duca tengernagyra bízzák az akció végrehajtását. A magyar csapat éppen Svájcban ját- szik, Duca tehát odautazik embereivel. A labdarúgokat két nyugaton élõ magyar--Bruno és Jóska--követi a szállodába, hogy töltõtollakat adjon el nekik. Véletlenül õket is lefény- képezik, s Duca tengernagy Jóskát raboltatja el. A szeren--csétlennek döntõ mérkõzésen kell játszania, a dolog botrányba fullad, s a szurkolók már-már forradalmat robbantanak ki..

Title: 786. Susanna tutta panna
description: A young woman gets closely watched by her jealous fiance while she is trying to deliver cakes to customers' houses.

Title: 787. Life at Stake
description: Attempting to reconstruct a criminal case, a radio presenter seeks the whereabouts of a robber who has recently finished a prison sentence, leading him into danger.

Title: 788. Tag til marked i Fjordby
description: The creepy villain Lasse Larsen has a fantastic power over one of his half-sister lineage dancer Lillian. He has a dangerous hypnotic grip on her and forces her - under hypnosis - to commit burglary.

Title: 790. Wraki
description: Diver Antoni Barnat is falsely accused of causing an accident underwater that almost led to his fellow diver's death. Interestingly enough, they are both in love with the same girl, Teresa.

Title: 792. La dulce enemiga
description: The story of a femme fatale whose adventures are narrated in flashbacks by the ghosts of her former lovers.

Title: 793. Night Girls
description: A whirlwind romance between a Danish storeclerk and an American G.I. in Copenhagen takes them to a dance club base for prostitutes, whom she befriends and whose pimp he antagonizes.

Title: 795. Donnez-moi ma chance
description: 17 year-old small-town girl Nicole Noblet comes to Paris dreaming of becoming a world-famous actress

Title: 796. Desert Warrior
description: Prince Saïd escapes his father's murderers, sent by traitor Ibrahim who quickly takes over the throne. Becoming a desert bandit he fights to get back his rights, meeting in the meantime beautiful Amina, Ibrahim's daughter.

Title: 798. La bestia humana
description: From Emile Zola's novel "La Bete Humaine", tells the story of a jealous husband, a provocative woman and a man with an uncontrollable desire to kill.

Title: 799. Zoku sûpâ jaiantsu
description: Super Giant (Starman in USA films) continues his battle against the foreign terrorists from Merapolia who are trying to destroy Earth with nuclear weapons. They retaliate by framing him for murder among his allies.

Title: 801. 91:an Karlsson slår knockout
description: The boxing champion of the world Ingemar Johansson learn 91:an how to box.

Title: 802. Fata ahlami
description: A young poor inventor impersonates a famous wealthy role in order to win his wealthy girl's love and her father's approval for his discovery.

Title: 803. Gelinin muradi
description: The love of Doctor Murat and Menekse in a village.

Title: 805. Only People
description: An one-legged engineer of hydro construction and a war veteran meets a blind girl in a mountain sanatorium of Ophthalmology during winter. She's waiting for a surgery that can restore her eyesight. Soon the two fall in love with each other, but he feels unpleasant because of his handicap she's yet aware of.

Title: 806. Proti vsem
description: As the Hussite Wars spread across Bohemia, Jan Zizka rallies the people of Prague to beat back Emperor Sigismund's mercenary crusaders at Vítkov Hill.

Title: 807. Seven Mysteries
description: A samurai rescues a mischievous tanuki from hunters and sets it free. When the samurai's wastrel son hatches a plot to kill his father for his fortune, the magical tanuki is determined to protect its rescuer.

Title: 809. The Depraved
description: U.S. Army captain stationed in England has an affair with a local married woman. Together they hatch a plan to kill her husband.

Title: 810. The False Prince
description: The Sultan awaits the arrival of his son, Prince Omar, who has brought up in a distant land. The master tailor and his assistances are making clothes for the prince. Labakan, the most gifted of his assistances, craves to be a Sovereign's heir. He steals the princely garments. Labakan poses as the Sultan's son. The Sultan trusts him but the prince's mother recognizes his son. The Sultan organizes a tailoring contest between the two pretenders. Labakan wins and this gives away his identity. However, in order to be sure, the Sultan orders them to choose between two boxes. One is inscribed with "Honor and Courage" and the other with "Happiness and Wealth". Labakan chooses the latter. He finds a needle and a pair of scissors inside... At this moment, Labakan awakes from his dream.

Title: 812. El tesoro de Pancho Villa
description: The hidden treasure of Pancho Villa is being searched by a group of bandits who plan to rob it from the Mexican people, but the masked hero known as "The Avenging Shadow" plans to stop them.

Title: 813. Bratya
description: Story of two brothers, stayed in different parts of Korea. Elder one works on recovery of electric plant. Younger brother comes back to native town with sabotage task.

Title: 814. Syntipukki
description: A poor young man gets a job as a scapegoat for other workers' mistakes in a fine department store.

Title: 815. Les violents
description: Pierre Tercelin who used to be a prosperous industrialist is now ruined and embittered, having become a mere lock keeper. A widower, he lives with his daughter Evelyne, a music-hall dancer. Claiming he is being persecuted by his cousin Edgar he gets in touch again with another cousin of his he hates, Bernard, a millionaire gun runner,who is also a victim of Edgar. It must be said that both Pierre and Bernard once caused Edgar to go bankrupt... Pierre offers Bernard to join efforts against Edgar. Soon after, Bernard dies of poison, which is only the first of a series of acts of violence. Tiercelin is shot at while going back home, Bernard's son is gunned down while his sister Luciane disappears. Chief-inspector Malouvier - who oddly enough looks very much like the suspect- investigates....

Title: 816. Police judiciaire
description: Several investigations take place in the premises of the French Criminal Police: a young lawbreaker is accused of having murdered his accomplice; a false witness working for a dangerous killer is interrogated; a double crime has been committed in a hotel without there being any sign of a break-in...

Title: 817. Nausherwan-E-Adil
description: A fair-minded emperor improves and introduces new laws, but ends up facing challenges when his son violates them.

Title: 818. Parola di ladro
description: Parola di ladro (1957) film of refined example of Italian comedy with a touch of mystery. The plot revolves around Desiderio, a gentleman thief and crime, highly skilled in forging jewelry like Arsène Lupin. rare examples of Italian films

Title: 820. Ak altin
description: The story of a group of people chasing a treasure.

Title: 821. La justicia del gavilán vengador
description: Set somewhere in rural México circa 1950, the story revolves around the return of a large land owner's son to their parents' state (hacienda) at a time when a criminal ring is vandalizing them and other villagers. A bit before, a masked man, called "el gavilán", starts acting like a Robin Hood, and thus gains locals' appreciation. Regional songs, gunshots, love rivalries, etc.

Title: 822. El bandido generoso
description: On the orders of the son of the mayor of a small Andalusian village, a sacristan is hired to dress up as a bandit from Sierra Morena in order to attract tourists. At first, the plan is a mess.

Title: 823. Lal Batti
description: This is a film set in a train and on a lonely railway platform where passengers are forced to spend a night at the time of India's Independence.

Title: 825. Suspended Alibi
description: A married editor who is having an affair pretends that he is visiting an army friend, to keep his wife from suspecting him of infidelity. But while he is with the girlfriend, his friend is murdered, and the editor is suspected of the crime.

Title: 826. El gato sin botas
description: Agustín is a coward man and he is in love with Laura, a movie actress. He travels to Mexico City to find her and lives many adventures. His grandpa reminds him the history of the Puss'n Boots.

Title: 827. Shock Patrol
description: A somber meditation on a war already lost.

Title: 828. Bandi
description: A much married Shankar works for a Zamindar and falls for his daughter Mala.But the Zamindar gets him arrested for a murder.His younger brother Madhav takes responsibility of his wife and daughter but Shankar's wife passes away.Madhav brings up his daughter and arranges her marriage but the boy turns out to be son of the Zamindar.When Shankar gets released he marries Mala and sets out for revenge nearly killing Madhav.

Title: 829. Shôrisha
description: Intersecting circles of obligation link a former boxer, the youth he vows to make a champion, and the ex-showgirl whose ballet training he funds, in a story balanced between the Ginza boxing ring and the highbrow world of the ballet studio.

Title: 830. La polka des menottes
description: Elisabeth is persuaded to have killed her noisy upstairs neighbor, scientist Charles Magne. To save her, Mr. Matheu, Elisabeth's father, accuses himself while Pierrot, Elisabeth's fiancé gets rid of the body in order to save father and daughter. For his part, a gangster also believes he has killed the scientist but he gets shot down by a taxidermist, who runs for life. The girl, her daddy and her boyfriend also run away. But Magne is not dead. A bum is mistaken for him and a police inspector makes everyone believe that he is the one who shot the gangster. At the end of this crazy chain of events all the protagonists are reunited at the station house and everybody dances to express their relief.

Title: 831. The King's Musketeers
description: The three best of the disbanded Musketeers - Athos, Porthos, and Aramis - join a young hotheaded would-be-Musketeer, D'Artagnan, to stop the Cardinal Richelieu.

Title: 833. The Young Don't Cry
description: A Georgia orphanage teenager gets involved with a chain gang convict who is planning his escape from the nearby prison camp.

Title: 834. Prithibi Amare Chaay
description: Tapas Singha is an aspiring singer and the son of a reputed businessman. His stepmother gives him a bad name and throws him out of his house to inherit all the property of her husband. Mina's story is also very similar. Her stepmother tortures her a lot and ruins her career. She is compelled to move out of her own house. They both decide to commit suicide and go to the riverbank. Where they meet and the cupid strikes. Together they decide to give life one more tries; on the other hand, we get to see another couple Lalu and Leela. Leela is a cousin of Tapas and Lalu, the goon with a heart of gold is a neighbour of Mina. Lalu and Leela were married in the childhood, but they were separated due to unfortunate circumstances. Tapas and Mina in search of a living starts to work for a millionaire and his wife respectively. But problem arises again as the employer thinks that Tapas is having an affair with his wife and fires him. Mina breaks down and starts to search for Tapas as he goes missing. Finally, during the climax Mina and Tapas get reunited and so does Lalu and Leela, and the audience gets to see a happy ending.

Title: 835. What Fate Holds
description: Accompanied by his feathery associate, a wandering fortune-teller predicts the fates of passers-by to make a living. He encounters penniless lovers, incurable romantics, and unscrupulous con artists. But who knows what tomorrow holds?

Title: 836. Die Letzten werden die Ersten sein
description: Adaptation of a short Galsworthy play: The brother of a high ranking lawyer has killed the husband of a Polish woman, with whom he is having an affair. Can the counsel help his brother without getting himself involved in scandal?

Title: 837. La marca de Satanás
description: A peaceful pueblo is terrorized by an ax-wielding killer. After ghostly encounters and walking dead appear, a victim's brother arrives seeking revenge, but confronts evil while investigating.

Title: 839. Far til fire og onkel Sofus
description: Uncle Anders has a twin brother who lives in the US. His name is Sofus and on his 70th birthday he decides to go back to Denmark and celebrate with his family. Unfortunately Uncle Anders and Sofus don't get along well.

Title: 840. Scotland Yard Dragnet
description: After a test pilot is injured in a plane crash, his fiancée takes him to a psychiatrist. The psychiatrist is unhappily married and has a crush on the fiancée, and attempts to hypnotize the pilot into murdering his wife.

Title: 841. Behold Thy Son
description: This is the story of Kiyoshi Yoshida, who feels estranged from both parents after his father returns from war. How the boy adapts to life with the virtual stranger his father has become is the film's focus.

Title: 842. Northern Elegy
description: A young woman falls for a middle aged business man, but things get complicated when she also starts having feelings for his wife.

Title: 843. Salzburger Geschichten
description: When visiting the Salzburg Festival wealthy Georg gets financial support from his Austrian friend due to the fact that during the thirties of the last century it was only allowed to take a very small amount of money across the border from Germany to Austria. One day they missed each other and Georg gets help from the parlor maid Konstanze to pay his bill in a cafe. Of course Georg falls for Konstanze. When he learns that she as well as the rest of the family is pretending being part of the domestic staff he cooperates to support Konstanze's father - owner and count of the castle - to collect some comic situations which he needs for his next theatrical comedy.

Title: 844. Kapelusz pana Anatola
description: Anatol Kowalski is an old man who works in a bank and loves his old-fashioned hat. One day the hat gets lost and Anatol decides to buy a new one. This new unique hat will bring him a lot of unexpected adventures. The next day, when he travels by bus to work, he surprisingly finds a watch in his pocket. The same thing happens on the following day. Anatol will soon realise that the local gang has mistaken him for their boss.

Title: 845. Johnny Gunman
description: Vicious Allie and laid-back Johnny G. are a couple of rival New York City gangsters who have known each other since childhood. After mob capo Lou Caddy gets busted by the authorities for tax evasion, Allie and Johnny G. find themselves caught up in a fierce territorial dispute over who will have exclusive control of the mob racket.

Title: 846. Med glorian på sned
description: A secretary at a publishing company, Birgitta, writes a novel, based on her secret love of her boss. She sends it anonymously to her own company, who decides to publish it. The book becomes a success. Birgitta's husband's mistress get hold of the script and confesses that *she* wrote the novel.

Title: 847. Sûpâ jaiantsu - Kaiseijin no majô
description: The 3rd Super Giant film, in which he saves Earth from the threat of the reptile-like Kapia Aliens. (Part 1 of 2)

Title: 848. S.O.S. Noronha
description: On the Brazilian island of Fernando de Noronha, in the middle of the Atlantic, a small base is a stopover for Aeropostale seaplanes, also a Brazilian penitentiary, where a revolt has broken out and threatens the survival of a few French

Title: 849. Asesinos, S.A.
description: An ordinary citizen is abducted and brainwashed to work as an expert assassin for the notorious murder association, Asesinos, S.A.

Title: 850. The Violators
description: Solomon Baumgarden is a New York City probation officer assisting teenagers through the court system.

Title: 851. Tudja zemlja
description: A story about Italian soldiers, enemies who have their own problems and hopes. Based on short stories of Mesa Selimovic, Bosnian writer.

Title: 852. Bedari
description: This is a patriotic Pakistani movie made to pay tribute to the Father of the Nation, Mohammad Ali Jinnah . This was remake of Bollywood movie 'Jagriti'.

Title: 853. Ukifune
description: Ukifune is the story of its eponymous heroine, a beautiful young woman, and two remarkable Heian noblemen. Its events unfold 20 years after the death of Shining Prince Genji.

Title: 854. Yakke Wali
description: Story of a brave woman of punjab earning livelihood for his family driving a tanga

Title: 855. The Golden Age of Comedy
description: A compilation of scenes featuring some of the best-known comics from the silent era in their best films.

Title: 856. Frühling in Berlin
description: Bad weather conditions over Denmark force a plane on the way from Vienna to Copenhagen to stop in Berlin. This is a problem for two wanted bank robbers who are on board.

Title: 857. Booby Trap
description: An absent minded professor invents a pen that will explode on the sound of bells, then leaves it in a taxi.

Title: 858. Stresemann
description: The efforts of the German Foreign Minister, Gustav Stresemann, to achieve European unity and world peace are shown through the eyes of two young people.

Title: 859. Die unentschuldigte Stunde
description: When a school student fakes sickness to skip a test, she falls in love with the handsome doctor. The partnership takes a serious turn soon, and puts her Abitur in jeopardy.

Title: 860. The Men of Tohoku
description: The isolated village of Tohoku is surrounded by high mountains, and has a tradition that only the eldest sons may marry and inherit. The filthy, unshaven younger sons, called yakkos, work the land and never have sex. To redress an ancestor's crime, the widow Oei has to take each yakko for a night. However she refuses to take Risuke, who has particularly vile breath. So Risuke's eldest brother Tasuke tells his wife Asa to take Risuke for a night, while an old blabbermouth suggests another alternative to Risuke.

Title: 863. Taynata vecherya na sedmatzite
description: Every household that has joined the cooperative farm is entitled to a plot of land for private use. The Sedmaks family live together but the elder son Krum want the family to separate on paper as to be given more land. The younger son, Nayden, has passed the university entrance exams but his admission is not assumed because the village Party secretary has given him a bad character reference. He returns to the village in search of justices. The president of cooperative farm has faith in the young man and tries to help him. Krum and his family set up a separate household, though the family all continue to have supper together. Nayden is not aware of what is going on. Yanka, the daughter of the president of cooperative farm, is in love with Nayden. The two meet every evening. One evening the Sedmaks family leaves their door unlocked. The farm president comes and finds them together. The fraud comes out into the open. The farm president forbids his daughter to meet Nayden. Yanka no longer trusts the boy either. After he fatal supper The Sedmaks clan have a quarrel, which ends with a real separation. Nayden leaves his father's home. The head of the family, old Sedmak, and Krum admit their guilt. On second thoughts, Yanka goes back to Nayden. Nayden receives a god reference, marries Yanka, and he young couple leave for the town to study.

Title: 864. Naughty New York
description: A bored French painter seeks new subjects when landscapes and still lifes no longer inspire him. His agent recommends painting women, leading them to find willing models at a nightclub - singers, dancers and strippers.

Title: 869. Godini za lyubov
description: Dr Ganevski leaves his wife Maria and his grown-up children Rositza and Chavdar for Dr Troyanovska, who has been widowed by the war. Her son, Angel, a school dropout, is in love with Rositza. Rositza renounces her father. Up to a point, Chavdar can understand Ganevski's decision. Hoping to live in affluence, the boy moves in with his father's new family. Dr Ganevski cannot bring himself to visit his daughter who is ill with the pneumonia. On his birthday, which he celebrates at his father's, Chavdar feels terribly lonely and leaves him.

Title: 871. Great Is My Country
description: A 90-minute panoramic documentary released provides a broad visual overview of the Soviet Union during the mid-20th century. The film presents a range of subjects, including natural landscapes, industrial development, and scenes of everyday life. Featured locations and activities include the Sochi-Ritsa highway, metallurgical facilities in Magnitogorsk, oil fields near the Caspian Sea, the construction of the Kuybyshev Hydroelectric Station, timber rafting in Transcarpathia, agricultural work in the steppes, large-scale infrastructure projects of the Sixth Five-Year Plan, as well as urban views of Moscow and Leningrad. The documentary also includes coverage of the 6th World Festival of Youth and Students held in Moscow.

Title: 873. Barrel Piano, Poverty and Carnations
description: The impecunious duo of wandering musicians is struggling to eke out an existence, and Pavlaras' health is deteriorating. Now, they need Keti and Dimitris; but, it's been nearly three years since they last saw them. Where are they now?

Title: 874. Pekka ja Pätkä salapoliiseina
description: Pekka and Pätkä start a detective agency. Two businessmen give them a mission they think is impossible.

Title: 875. Pekka ja Pätkä ketjukolarissa
description: After a hit in the head Pekka and Pätkä have series of adventurous dreams.

Title: 877. Inn of the Floating Weeds
description: Young gangster wannabe is framed for a murder and sent to prison.

Title: 878. Englen i sort
description: Lennart Sommer is picked up by the police. His wife Elise is deeply shaken when the detective says that he is being charged for pimping.

Title: 880. Rostam va Sohrab
description: Part of "Shahnameh" is the adventures of "Rostam" and his relationship with "Tahmineh", the daughter of Shah Samangan, who gives birth to "Sohrab", and Sohrab meets his father in the conspiracies of "Hooman" at a young age. They fight without knowing each other's identities.

Title: 881. Que les hommes sont bêtes
description: Sylvie is a young cashier in a Montmartre café, "le bar des Philosophes", owned and run by Monsieur Marcel, a former safe cracker. One day, the pretty creature accepts to give a helping hand to two regulars, Francis and Josélito. But what the naive girl does not know is that the two men are gangsters and that they plan to steal 50 million francs deposited in the safe of Maître Roland Devert, a charming young notary. Actually things do not go according to plan all the more as a love story between the notary and Sylvie was not at all on the two gangsters' agenda.

Title: 884. ¡Aquí están los Aguilares!
description: The Aguilar brothers, Luis and Antonio, arrive at the farm of Anita, the young rich widow of a colonel, whom both try to seduce, while also having to deal with a band of cattle rustlers.

Title: 886. Onore e sangue
description: A humble clerk is forced to take on debts to cure his mother.

Title: 887. Troop 11
description: Everything about the boys - their pranks - frolics - and escapades - a picture every boy - girl and everybody else should not miss.

Title: 889. Pekka ja Pätkä sammakkomiehinä
description: After an unsuccessful tour as a musical duo, Pekka and Pätkä are called for refresher training as divers in the army.

Title: 890. O Gato de Madame
description: Rich woman offers a large sum of money to whomever finds her stray cat.

Title: 891. Potrazi Vandu Kos
description: A woman comes to Sarajevo to find out more about her brother's death. The only source she has is a message on a piece of paper she got from him: "Look for Vanda Kos".

Title: 892. Ekaterina Voronina
description: Ekaterina Voronina firmly showed her will, did not tolerate concessions both in her work and in her personal life. Her harsh adherence to principles did not allow her to believe even her beloved man.

Title: 893. Laan mig din kone
description: A man is hoping for a promotion but only married men get promoted. He borrows his friend's wife for a staff dinner party. He's seated next to the boss's daughter and the boss with the hot "wife". The fun begins.

Title: 895. Torawakamaru, the Koga Ninja
description: Teenaged wizard-ninja Torawakamaru of the Koga Clan must unmask traitors working with members of the nefarious Iga Ninja and rescue a princess from deadly danger.

Title: 896. Hum Panchhi Ek Daal Ke
description: Rajendra Mehra is the only child of Rai Bahadur Kailalshnath, and studies in a school along with Nandu, Mehmood, Chatpat, Guru, and others. He decides to go on an outing with them, incurring the anger of his dad, who at first sends his servant, Dhamu, to bring him back. When Dhamu fails, he sends Mirza Usman, and when Mirza too fails to bring Rajendra home, Kailashnath himself sets out himself, but when he reaches them, he finds that the children have already left for home. Angered at his son for mixing with poor students, he decides to remove him from the school and have him taught at home - and the person he has recruited is none other than Shaktimaan Singh - a Circus Ringmaster. The question remains will Shaktimaan be able to appropriately discipline Rajendra?

Title: 897. Susana y yo
description: An explosive star of a variety theatre cannot decide between the love of an honest archaeology professor and the love of an extravagant official who turns himself into a cabaret comedian in his spare time.

Title: 898. This Is Russia!
description: Documentary footage of late 1950s Russia covers such cities and towns as Moscow, Leningrad, Kiev, Yalta, the Black Sea, Kharkov, Sochi, Sukumi, Gori, Bukhara, Samarkand, Frunzo and Siberia. In Tbilisi, Georgia, cameras capture what the narrator describes as a fight between police and students. Daily Soviet life is represented, from women performing heavy labor to a state-sponsored fashion show. The film also makes note of the Sputnik spaceship launches, depicting Russian university students as future scientists. Scenes include children playing in a park, sailboats cruising the Ukraine, crude shanty towns, a trip through a government-owned grocery store and the cathedrals of pre-Soviet Russia.

Title: 899. Manalane Mangayin Bhagyam
description: A prince gets banished from his kingdom when he is falsely accused by a girl. His life turns worse when a sage grants him three wishes, which he eventually loses to thugs.

Title: 901. The Big Fun Carnival
description: The first of a series of 12 compilation features (number 1-12)made for theatres to use as a Saturday Matinee offering aimed strictly at children. Marian Stafford, folk-singer Jared Reed, and The Bunin Puppets appear before and after each cartoon short. All of the cartoon shorts were originally released by Paramount, and included "The 500 Hats of Bartholomew Cubbins (1943)" - Betty Boop's "Crazy Town (1932)" - "The Silly Goose/Dumme Ganslein, Der (1945)" - "The Busy Little Bears (1939)" - "Toys Will Be Toys (1949)", and other Paramount cartoons, shorts and a couple of the audience-participation Screen Song singalong shorts. Strictly sold on a "Park-the-kids-and-go-shopping" or "Cheap Baby-Sitting" basis, and, since it was geared toward the kids, there was also a bath-room break intermission about halfway through the film. New footage and some of the cartoons in Technicolor, but a few of the cartoons were black-and-white.

Title: 904. Printemps à Paris
description: Gisèle, a young provincial woman is going to Paris riding on a bicycle.Sudddenly she has a flat tire, but a young Parisian driving a car with Belgian registration stops and proposes her to travel with him to Paris.As Gièle wants to know Paris, the young man, Pierre, proposes to be her guide.When they separated in Paris Gisèl gives him a phone number that she saw on a board.But later Pierre meets again Gisèle who says that she has now a program.So begins the game of hide and seek between them.

Title: 906. Vater sein dagegen sehr
description: Lutz Ventura is a writer in a small town. There he lives an idyllic life with his fiancée Margot. When his widowed sister suddenly dies, he takes in her two children Traudl and Rudi. This inevitably leads to complications.

Title: 907. Mese a 12 találatról
description: A tale about Budapest in the 1950-s, where a teacher in love, a naive young maid, a respectful waiter and a busy doctor become unlikely friends with the same purpose: to win the main price of the "Totó"-lottery.

Title: 908. Der schönste tag meines lebens
description: Tony, a young orphan, is accused of stealing a bank note belonging to his mistress. Annoyed, he runs away from school .

Title: 909. Rihlah Gharamiyyah
description: The film revolves around Hamdi (Shukri Sarhan), who recently married Nadyah, the daughter of his aunt (Maryam Fakhruddin). He faces a problem in his new job, which requires that job occupants to be single. He falls in great trouble between having to keep his marriage secret, and dealing with the growing interest of Layla (Samirah Ahmad), daughter of company's director. Sulayman, his colleague at work, tries to help him solve this problem.

Title: 910. The Fisherman's Son
description: The 1930s. Young fisherman Oskars Klava dreams of new nets to help him gain independence from the collector Garoza but he lacks the trust of old fishermen.

Title: 911. Bed of Grass
description: Agioupa, an unruly orphan girl, sleeps in the fields, choosing the company of the birds to her fellow villagers.

Title: 912. Die Prinzessin von St. Wolfgang
description: Josefa Maria comes from an Old Austrian Noble family and is (due to her ancestry) promised to a noble Count. As she visits her hometown St. Wolfgang on vacation, she falls in love with the charming Car Mechanic Toni Leitner. Josefa soon decides to marry Toni. However, her Grandma, afraid of a public scandal, arranges a transfer of Leitner to Australia.

Title: 913. Avitsenna
description: A movie about X century philosopher, doctor, scientist and poet from Bukhara known in the West as Ibn Sina.

Title: 915. En drömmares vandring
description: Portrait of Swedish poet Dan Andersson. Brought up during poor conditions he finds work as a temperance preacher and educator. Bored by this he travels to Stockholm hoping to be published.

Title: 917. Bir serseri
description: Mahmut Bey, who takes a large amount of money from the company he works for, to Adana, meets Nermin on the train. Using her femininity and beauty, she steals his money.

Title: 920. En liberté sur les routes d'URSS
921. Krisalis
description: BIG in star value - BIG in story value - BIG in human value.

Title: 925. Ni shi wo de ling hun
926. Fincho
description: Fincho comes to terms with the industrialization of Nigeria, colonialism, the tension between tradition and innovation, and mechanization's threat to traditional labor.

Title: 928. Berdus
description: The story of Berdus Bedri, who was forced to shine shoes and steal by his older brother.

Title: 931. It Could Be You
description: Two London models on their journey through Germany as their prize for winning a newspaper competition.

Title: 933. Male stvari
description: Wife of a doctor, who's busy with his work over the top, lets herself to adventure. Much effort is needed to overcome "little" argues and to find the way of understanding and respect.

Title: 935. Sylviane de mes nuits
description: Michel Lenoir, a successful interior designer, has reached the middle of his life without ever getting married. A bit blue over it he dreams one night of a beautiful young woman. When he wakes up he is persuaded that this is the girl meant for him. He can't help thinking about her, talking about her, drawing her figure, her face, her eyes on paper. He even gives her a name: Sylviane. Later on, as he is holidaying in Portugal, he notices a charming girl swimming in the pool he is in. No doubt about it : he has found Sylviane. He follows her, talks to her, woos her and they are soon married. However, back in Paris, Michel realizes that Betty, an articulate sports writer, is not the idealized woman his brain had conceived. Things go awry and the couple is about to separate when well-meaning friends intervene and open up Michel's eyes : he must base his love story on everyday reality not on idle dreaming.

Title: 937. Ascoltami
description: A famous singer abandons his wife and goes to live abroad with a woman he met in a night club. A car accident upsets his life - he loses his job and his new love but he regains his sons and peace of mind.

Title: 944. Zimowy zmierzch
description: Rumsza, the elderly railwayman, leading a sedate life with his wife, misses his only remaining son (two older boys were killed in the war). Joziuk finally returns from the military in the first scene but with the pregnant Zosia, while Rumsza expected him to marry Celinka, the daughter of Krywka, his only friend and neighbor. The hero will not accept the new situation; he throws his son and Zosia out of his house. Celinka is distressed but she still harbors hope for Joziuk. The birth of the child changes the situation: Rumsza accepts his son's relationship but Celinka decides to leave.

Title: 945. Sherlock de Araque
description: Two clumsy guards have to patrol Copacabana streets at night.

Title: 947. I'll Be Back
description: A war disabled lieutenant colonel, who did not make it in the society, after many years of loneliness meets happy woman who loved him in the past, and not forgotten him despite the fact that she married meanwhile.

Title: 948. El andén
description: Vallina is a small town where all its relation with the outside revolves around the platform, in which only two trains leave the mail and a freight train. After forty years of service, the stationmaster retires. The town prepares a tribute and when the party is in full swing, the Talgo appears. To the surprise of all, the chief unfolds the red flag and stops the train that the neighbors have always seen as a meteor. But that action will not be well seen by the leadership of Renfe and the stationmaster is sanctioned. The people's response is immediate and popular mobilization is not long in coming.

Title: 952. Serenate per 16 bionde
description: Some French girls on holiday in Italy take refuge in a castle because of a storm. The morning after the owner of the castle and his friends reach the place and some love stories start. A rum character tries to turn the place into a hotel and finances the venture with bounced cheques...

Title: 953. Ce sacré Amédée
description: A manager asks a beginner to replace a singer who has canceled her concert.

Title: 954. A sud niente di nuovo
description: Love is in the air between a dancer and an actress from a theater company. The boy follows the girl on her tour and does everything to join the company.

Title: 957. Espadang Umaangil
description: Thrilling Adventure and Dangerous Romance flood the screen when EFREN fights for a throne and the woman he LOVES.

Title: 965. Kamelyali Kadin: Günahsiz Fahise
description: Based on Alexandre Dumas Fils novel.

Title: 968. La revolución mexicana en sus murales
description: The revolution in Mexico marked a profound change in the life of a society that sought and needed a transformation in all its structures. Muralism became the most important artistic phenomenon of twentieth-century Mexican art, and it is the one that finally projected it to the rest of the world, definitively making it independent of European aesthetics.
